blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: First-person manipulation datasets treat the observation-action pair as the atomic unit and compress the generation and execution of an action into a policy network's weights, rendering the intent state behind the action unobservable. Human motor control research shows that intent mediates between observation and action and leaves observable traces along the intent pathway from decision to effect: gaze reaches the target before the hand, muscle load builds before contact, and cortical activity precedes the motor command. To record this pathway at scale, we present HumanCOIN, a first-person manipulation dataset built around human intent: 12,500 hours across 38 scene classes with three tiers of proxies. At the output end, the L1 attention tier (10,000 h) infers gaze from headband camera video, exposing the operator's next object of attention and reach before the hand moves. Midway, the L2 exertion tier (2,000 h) records surface EMG from armbands, making load expectations readable before execution is complete. At the origin, the L3 cognition tier (500 h) records scalp EEG, giving early readouts of task decisions and monitoring. Each tier inherits all proxies from the tiers below. The dataset further provides multi-view RGB images, depth maps and point clouds, 6-DoF head and wrist pose, and step-level action and object annotations. The controlled L3 setting additionally measures gaze, hand pose and finger kinematics directly. Clock and calibration data are released with the dataset so that any read rate can be re-aligned. The three tiers cover three stations, from visual orienting to cortical preparation, making the process behind visual-action pairs available for modeling at dataset scale. Project page: https://flagopen.github.io/HumanCOIN.
blocks.zh: 第一人称操纵数据集将观测-动作对子视为原子单位,并将动作的生成和执行压缩为政策网络的权重,使得动作背后的意图状态无法观察. 人类运动控制研究显示,意图介于观察与动作之间,并沿意图路径留下可观察到的痕迹,从决定到生效:眼睛在手前到达目标,肌肉负荷在接触前积聚,皮质活动在运动指令之前. 为了记录这种规模的路径,我们介绍了HumanCOIN,一个以人类意图为核心的第一人称操纵数据集:在38个场景课上共12,500小时,并有三层代词. 在输出端,L1关注级(10,000 h)从头带镜头视频中推断出凝视,暴露了操作员的下一个关注对象,并在手动前到达. 中途,L2施加级(2,000 h)记录从臂带表面显示EMG,使负载预期在执行完成前可以读取. 最初,L3识别级(500 h)记录头皮脑电图,提前宣读任务决定和监测。 每一级继承下一级的所有代位. 数据集进一步提供多视图RGB图像,深度地图和点云,6-DoF头和手腕姿势,以及步态动作和对象说明. 受控L3设定额外测量 凝视,手姿和手指动静直接。 与数据集一起发布时钟和校准数据,这样任何读速率都可以重新对齐. 三层覆盖三个站台,从视觉定向到皮质准备,使视觉动作对后的过程在数据集尺度上可供建模. 项目网页:https://flagopen.github.io/HumanCOIN。

learning. A head-mounted camera records the scene from the operator’s viewpoint,
hand pose recovers the motion of the hands, and together they form a

blocks.en:
The tiers are nested in instrumentation: each inherits every proxy of the tier
below and takes on one more, each proxy being a suite of instruments rather than a
single device. Depth is a design axis, not a separate collection: the families that
survive the same canonical filters at every tier recur at all three measurement
depths on a shared time base. Scene, objects, posture, and protocol nonetheless
move with depth, so a cross-tier comparison is task-matched rather than
condition-matched; Section 3.1 states what the shared families hold fixed and
what they leave open. The three
proxies are recorded by the three tiers, and the action a a itself is captured by
the egocentric video every tier carries: z z remains latent, but m m is recorded
rather than marginalised. Beyond the
tier-specific modalities, the dataset provides depth maps and 3D point clouds
reconstructed from egocentric views, 6-DoF head and wrist pose with finger
kinematics, and step-level action–object annotations, all registered to a single
coordinate frame and time axis. L3 serves as a multimodal reference in its controlled
setting: there, m gaze m_{\text{gaze}} , head and wrist pose, and finger kinematics are
measured directly with dedicated instruments, while their counterparts at L1, at L2, and
in the open L3 subset are predicted from multiview video, aligning all three tiers in semantics, coordinate
frame, and time base so that the controlled measurements provide per-frame
reference targets for shallow-tier predictors.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Egocentric Vision Corpora
blocks.zh: 2.1 以爱神为中心的愿景

blocks.en: Egocentric video has been scaled along two axes, hours and annotation density. Ego4D [ grauman2022ego4d ] collected 3,670 hours from 931 participants in nine countries and defined benchmarks for episodic memory, forecasting, and social interaction. EPIC-KITCHENS [ damen2018epic ] traded breadth for density, annotating cooking with verb–noun segments; its hundred-hour extension, EPIC-KITCHENS-100 [ damen2020rescaling ] , added 89K action segments. EGTEA Gaze+ [ li2020eye ] recorded eye movements over 28 hours of cooking and turned attention into a label. Ego-Exo4D [ grauman2024egoexo4d ] added a synchronized third-person view: 1,286 hours from 740 participants, annotated with skills, keysteps, and proficiency.
blocks.zh: 以爱果心为主题的视频沿着两个轴线,小时和注释密度进行了缩放. Ego4D[grauman2022ego4d]从9个国家的931名参与者那里收集了3,670个小时,并确定了零星记忆、预测和社会互动的基准。 EPIC-KITCHENS [damen2018epic] 交易密度宽度,用动词–名词片段注释烹饪;其百小时扩展,EPIC-KITCHENS-100 [damen2020rescaling],增加了89K动作片段. EGTEA Gaze+ [li2020eye]录制了超过28小时烹饪的眼动,并将注意力转化为标签. Ego-Exo4D [grauman2024egoexo4d]增加了同步第三人称视图:1,286小时从740名参与者开始,附加了技能,键步,以及熟练度.

blocks.en: Assembly101 [ sener2022assembly101 ] instrumented tabletop assembly with 4,321 multi-view videos; ARCTIC [ fan2023arctic ] captured bimanual manipulation of articulated objects with 2.1M frames and 3D hand–object annotations; HOI4D [ liu2022hoi4d ] recorded 2.4M RGB-D frames of category-level hand–object interaction; and HoloAssist [ sener2023holoassist ] annotated 166 hours of human–assistant collaboration, including mistakes and their corrections.

blocks.en:
A newer generation raises the bar on geometry and duration: Nymeria [ ma2024nymeria ] captures multimodal daily motion with full-body and hand tracking, HD-EPIC [ perrett2025hdepic ] adds 3D object and gaze grounding to kitchen annotation, EgoDex [ hoque2026egodex ] records 829 hours of manipulation with on-device 3D hand tracking, and EgoLife [ yang2025egolife ] follows six participants for a week. All remain external observations: none records muscle or cortex during the act.
EgoSuite-Open100K [ egosuite2026 ] has opened the first 10,000 hours of a planned 100,000-hour programme of egocentric manipulation, with 3D hand and body pose over 10,000 tasks and 500 environments, and Xperience-10M [ xperience10m2026 ] releases 10,000 hours and 2.88B RGB frames of in-the-wild human experience with depth, camera pose, and captions. Both record the outside of the action at a scale no research corpus reaches. Neither records gaze, muscle, or cortex, and neither pairs the same task with a shallower version of itself.

blocks.en: 2.2 Physiological and Neural Sensing
blocks.zh: 2.2 生理和神经遥感

blocks.en:
Surface EMG has long served as the interface between motor intent and machine.
Farina et al. [ farina2014extraction ] review how motor-unit activity is
extracted from the surface signal and used to decode intended movement and force,
and Ninapro [ atzori2014ninapro ] standardised forearm recordings across
subjects. Grip-force studies show that forearm muscles load to the anticipated
object weight before the object leaves the surface [ johansson1988weight , johansson2009coding ] , encoding the operator’s prior over object properties as an
observable EMG signal before any visual feedback is available. EgoEMG [ egoemg2026 ] pairs bilateral forearm EMG with egocentric video for hand pose estimation.

blocks.en:
EEG-based interfaces have decoded motor preparation, error monitoring, and
cognitive load for decades [ wolpaw2002brain ] . Kornhuber and Deecke
identified the Bereitschaftspotential, a slow cortical build-up that precedes
voluntary movement by hundreds of milliseconds [ kornhuber1965 ] , and
Shibasaki and Hallett provide a systematic account of its neural
basis [ shibasaki2006bp ] . Gehring et al. established the error-related
negativity (ERN): cortex produces a discriminable response within milliseconds of
an incorrect outcome, before any external feedback [ gehring1993ern ] . Taking
EEG outside the laboratory is complicated by motion artefacts; the mobile
brain/body imaging paradigm [ gramann2011mobilebrainbody ] and active-electrode
hardware have made wearable acquisition feasible, though signal quality remains
below that of seated recordings.

blocks.en:
Gaze provides the earliest behavioural signature of intent: it reaches the target
of a pointing movement before the hand does [ neggers2000ocular ] , and
appearance-based trackers [ krafka2016gazecapture ] made the signal recordable
outside the laboratory; in everyday tasks fixations run ahead of the hand and
mark the objects about to be acted on [ land2001 , hayhoe2005 ] ; and in object
manipulation gaze reaches the contact point before the fingers
close [ johansson2001 ] . Pupil diameter adds a physiological readout of
processing load [ beatty1982 ] . When gaze and EEG are recorded together,
fixation-related potentials lock cortical activity to the currently fixated
object [ dimigen2011 ] , showing that the three signals are mutually
constraining rather than independent.

The neuroergonomics programme [ parasuraman2007neuroergonomics ] argued that
these measurements belong inside real tasks. Most studies nevertheless remain
laboratory experiments: the task is designed to elicit a signal, scenes are
controlled, participants few and trials short, so behaviour, muscle, and cortex
are rarely recorded on one timeline. EgoBrain [ lin2026egobrain ] pairs a
32-channel EEG headset with egocentric video over 61 hours from 40 participants,
the first corpus to put cortex on the same timeline as first-person video; it is
seated and scripted, however, covering 29 daily actions in one setting, with no
gaze, no muscle, and no scene geometry. Large-scale synchronised recording of all
three signals in naturalistic manipulation scenes has not been achieved.

blocks.en: 2.3 Human Data for Robot Learning
blocks.zh: 2.3 机器人学习的人类数据

blocks.en:
Human video has long been used to teach robots, but the methods differ in what they inherit from the human.
TCN [ sermanet2018tcn ] learned a self-supervised video representation for imitation, DexMV [ qin2022dexmv ] brought human video and estimated hand pose to dexterous manipulation, R3M [ nair2022r3m ] pretrained a visual representation on Ego4D and transferred it to manipulation, VRB [ bahl2023vrb ] extracted affordances from human videos as a representation for robot policies, and EgoMimic [ kareer2024egomimic ] scaled imitation learning from egocentric human video captured with a portable rig. These methods inherit appearance and affordance from the human, but not the signals that produced the action.

人类的视频长期以来被用于教导机器人,但方法与人类继承的东西不同.
TCN [sermanet2018tcn] 学会了一种自我监督的录像演示用于模仿,DexMV [qin2022dexmv] 带来了人类的视频和估计的手姿来进行狡猾的操控,R3M [nair2022r3m]在Ego4D上预先训练了一个视觉演示并转移到了操控,VRB [bahl2023vrb]从人类视频中提取了作为机器人政策演示的支付力,以及EgoMimic [kare2024egomimic] 从用便携式钻机捕获的自我中心人类视频中吸取的大规模模仿. 这些方法继承了人类的外表和承受力,而不是产生动作的信号.

blocks.en:
A second line introduces an explicit intermediate between o o and a a by
choosing the future. UniPi [ du2023unipi ] casts the policy as a video
diffusion model and reads actions from the generated frames; GR-1 [ wu2024gr1 ] jointly predicts future frames and actions in a transformer; VPP [ hu2025vpp ] and UVA [ li2025uva ] condition the policy on latent
representations of predicted future observations. These models make the gap
between o o and a a explicit, but the intermediate they supervise is a predicted
future observation rather than the operator’s current state: the two diverge when
an attempt fails or is abandoned, and neither grip force nor cortical preparation
is recoverable from a predicted frame.

A third line adds modalities to the policy itself. Any2Policy [ any2policy2024 ] trains a modality-agnostic encoder that accepts text, audio, images, or point

audio—into task plans with explicit control parameters. Play to the

dynamic weighting during manipulation. These works show that extra modalities
help a policy, and some already incorporate EMG at the policy end; none, however,
is grounded in a corpus that systematically records the operator’s intent proxies
across multiple depths under a shared task set and time base.

HumanCOIN holds 12 , 500 12,500 hours of egocentric manipulation data, organised
along three measurement depths: each tier corresponds to one observable proxy m gaze m_{\text{gaze}} , m emg m_{\text{emg}} , or m eeg m_{\text{eeg}} , from the visual orienting
signal at the pathway’s distal end, through the peripheral motor command, to
cortical preparatory activity. The corpus spans 38 scene classes,
99 task verbs, and 635 635 object classes. The three tiers share
a common task ontology and time base; scene and behavioural diversity unfold within
each tier.

blocks.en:
Beyond modalities, the tiers follow an open-to-controlled gradient in task,
scene, and acquisition paradigm: the deeper the tier, the more controlled and the
narrower its coverage. Open means the task happens in a natural scene in
the operator’s own way—objects occur as they occur, posture is unconstrained,
recording runs free. Controlled means the scene, object set, posture, and
acquisition protocol are fixed one by one, trading behavioural freedom for
reproducibility. The design keeps one task comparable across depths while the
corpus spans natural behaviour to controlled conditions.

blocks.en: 3.2 Episode Duration and Task Stages
blocks.zh: 3.2 阶段和任务阶段

blocks.en: Episode duration determines how much context and how many steps a single sample carries, and it largely constrains the kind of training and evaluation the sample can support. The duration of HumanCOIN is not set uniformly; it varies systematically with tier, task type, and difficulty.
blocks.zh: 集时段决定了一个单一样本有多少上下文和多少步骤,这在很大程度上制约了样本所能支持的培训和评价类型. HumanCOIN的期限没有统一规定;它因层次、任务类型和难度而有系统变化。

blocks.en: Duration distribution ( Figure 1 b). The distribution is unimodal with a long tail: the density peaks at 52 s and the mean sits at 88 s, with the shortest episodes near 10 s and an open tail beyond 5 min. The tiers differ systematically. L1 has the widest range and the heaviest tail, at a mean of 101 s; L2 and L3 are more concentrated, at 65 and 60 s. That gap belongs to the recording protocol rather than to the tasks: L1 is segmented after the fact from long continuous recordings, whereas L2 and L3 are scripted episodes with bounded sessions; electrode stability further shortens the deepest sessions. The gap is therefore not evidence about task difficulty, nor about depth as such.
blocks.zh: 时间分布(图1b)。 分布方式为单式,尾巴长:密度峰值为52s,中间坐落于88s,最短的几集接近10s,开阔的尾巴超过5分钟. 等级差别很大。 L1的射程最大,尾部最重,平均为101s;L2和L3的射程更集中,分别为65和60s. 这一空白属于记录协议而不是任务: L1在经过长时间连续录音后被分割开来,而L2和L3则是有限定会话的脚本片段;电极稳定性会进一步缩短最深的会话. 因此,这一差距不是任务困难的证据,也不是深度的证据。

blocks.en: Task stages ( Figure 1 c). Subtasks per episode count the stages a task is composed of rather than the temporal granularity of annotation. The count is highest at L1, at 11.0 per episode, where natural activity is split into many short steps; it falls to 8.3 at L2 and 7.9 at L3, where a fixed protocol groups the work into fewer, longer stages.
blocks.zh: 任务阶段(图1c)。 每集子任务计算一个任务由时间颗粒性注释构成的阶段. 计数最高的是L1,每集为11.0,自然活动分为许多短步;在L2为8.3,在L3为7.9,固定协议将工作分成更少,更长的阶段.

blocks.en: Overall, HumanCOIN shows clear tier differences along both duration and task structure: the shallow tiers hold long, loosely segmented, and diverse everyday activity, while the deep tiers concentrate on scripted, standardized tasks in which the same work is organized into fewer, longer stages. Duration characterizes the recording window, stage count characterizes task structure, and together they form the corpus’s spectrum from natural behaviour to complex controlled tasks.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,HumanCOIN在持续时间和任务结构上都显示出明显的层次差异:浅层具有较长的,松散的分层,以及多种多样的日常活动,而深层则集中于脚本化的标准化任务,在同一任务中,相同的工作被安排在更少,更长的阶段. 期限是记录窗口的特征,阶段计数是任务结构的特征,它们共同构成从自然行为到复杂受控任务的主体范围。

blocks.en: 3.3 Scene Distribution
blocks.zh: 3.3 场景分布

blocks.en: The value of egocentric data depends largely on how far it generalizes in the real world, so the scene distribution should not be trimmed for convenience of collection. The HumanCOIN scene vocabulary holds 38 classes, grouped into 5 zones—residential (9), commercial (10), professional (5), industrial (6), and public (7)—plus 1 residual class. Figure 1 d arranges them by zone and by tier, with the hours of each class stacked to show how the three tiers split the total; \appref app:scenes lists all 38 with their tier coverage.
blocks.zh: 以自我为中心的数据的价值很大程度上取决于它在现实世界的概括程度,因此场景分布不应该为了收集的方便而修剪. HumanCOIN场景词汇共有38个类,分为5个区——住宅区(9)、商业区(10)、专业区(5)、工业区(6)以及公共区(7)+1个剩余类。 图1d按区和等级排列,每类的时数叠叠,以显示三个等级如何分割总数;\appref app:scenses 列出所有38个等级的覆盖范围.

blocks.en: A residential centre of gravity. Residential holds 4 , 521 4,521 hours; commercial, 2 , 588 2,588 ; professional, 1 , 982 1,982 ; industrial, 1 , 957 1,957 ; public, 1 , 211 1,211 ; and the residual, 242 242 . The ordering is not incidental: manipulation is densest where people live and work, and the corpus follows that density rather than flattening it. Within each zone a few classes carry most of the hours—residential runs from the kitchen’s 1 , 175 1,175 hours down to the balcony’s 13 13 , while the industrial zone is led by the factory workshop at 1 , 168 1,168 and the professional zone by the office at 1 , 129 1,129 . Across the whole corpus the five largest classes take 39% of the hours, a concentration that mirrors how often those spaces are actually used.

blocks.en: Selective coverage by tier. L1 holds all 38 classes, L2 holds 21, and L3 holds 9, with the remaining 29 absent from L3; the 9 L3 classes account for 33.2% of L1 hours and 50.9% of L2. The scene set therefore contracts at each step—38 → \to 21 → \to 9, or 100% → \to 55 → \to 24% of the vocabulary—which is why the deep tier reads as a deliberate instrumented subsample rather than a miniature of the whole. Its nine classes are weighted toward the office, the dining room, the workroom, and the kitchen—spaces that admit a fixed desk, stable lighting, and a bounded session—while the controlled subset is narrower still, concentrated on the desk.
blocks.zh: 按层级进行选择性覆盖。 L1拥有全部38个班级,L2拥有21个班级,L3拥有9个班级,其余29个班级缺席L3;9个L3班占L1小时的33.2%,L2占50.9%. 因此,剧情设定为每一步——38~21~9~9~100%~55~24%的词汇——这就是为什么深层读作故意的仪器子样本而不是整体的迷你. 它的9个班级被加权到办公室、餐厅、工作室和厨房,这些班级允许固定的办公桌、稳定的照明和有限度的会议,而受控制的子集仍然比较狭窄,集中在办公桌上。

blocks.en: This is not a sampling bias but a direct consequence of the controlled setting: a high-density cap, an eye tracker, and a fixed desk require a fixed station, stable lighting, and a bounded session, and scenes such as the street, the shop floor, and the farm cannot physically accommodate them. The nine L3 classes are the classes with any L3 hours; the controlled subset is narrower still, concentrated on the desk. L1 is collected in open scenes, L2 in staged ones, and L3 spans both settings. The three tiers therefore differ in what they can record, and the scene distribution is a direct reflection of that difference.
blocks.zh: 这不是取样偏差,而是受控环境的直接后果:高密度的盖子,眼睛跟踪器,以及固定的办公桌需要固定的站台,稳定的照明,和有界限的会话,以及街道,商店地板等场景,农场无法实际容纳. 9门L3课是任何L3课时的课;受控子集仍然较窄,集中在桌子上. L1在公开场景中收集,L2在舞台上收集,L3横跨两个设置. 因此,三个层次在记录内容上有所不同,场景分布直接反映了这种差异.

blocks.en: Taken together, the scene distribution expresses a trade-off between diversity and record quality. From L1 to L3, coverage contracts from all 38 indoor and outdoor classes to a concentration on the 9 classes that can be instrumented. The result is a corpus that spans from natural behaviour to complex controlled tasks, with task families that recur across tiers observed at several measurement depths.

blocks.en: 3.4 Task Distribution
blocks.zh: 3.4 任务分配

blocks.en: A task entry is the unit of reuse: one captured segment, its ordered step sentences, and the objects it touches. The entries span cooking, assembly, cleaning, errands, and teaching, and differ in step count, object set, and manipulation difficulty; that variation is what allows the corpus to be split by domain, by horizon, or by difficulty instead of being used as one monolithic training set. Each step carries a task verb, the hand that performed it, and the objects it touches, so an entry can be read both as a plan and as a record of execution ( Figure 1 e,f). The upper tiers are, with few exceptions, subsets of the lower tiers: scenes are strictly nested (L3 ⊂ \subset L2 ⊂ \subset L1); objects and verbs are nested except for a small probe increment—five objects first added at L2 and six verbs first added at L3. Figure 1 d–f shows the resulting vocabulary split.
blocks.zh: 一个任务项是再利用的单位:一个捕获的段,它的顺序步骤句,以及它触及的对象. 这些条目涵盖烹饪、组装、清洁、杂务和教学,在步骤计数、对象设定和操纵难度方面各不相同;这种变化是允许将主体按域、地平线或困难划分,而不是作为一个单一的训练集。 每个步骤都带有任务动词,执行它的手,以及它碰到的物体,所以一个条目既可以读作计划,也可以读作执行记录(图1 e,f). 除少数例外情况外,上层是下层的子集:场景严格为筑巢(L3 ⊂\subset L2 ⊂\subset L1);物体和动词为筑巢,但小探针增量除外——5个物体先在L2加,6个动词先在L3加. 图1 d-f显示由此产生的词汇划分。

blocks.en: Action: 99 task verbs. A task verb names what a step accomplishes as a goal— wipe , open , fold —and is the unit a plan is written in. The vocabulary is open-ended in principle but compact in practice: 99 classes cover the step record, a median of 81 occurrences per class, and the ten most frequent take 60.0% of it. The head is everyday manipulation—wipe, open, fold, close, arrange—above a long tail of rarer verbs, so the same set serves both as a small label vocabulary and as a description fine-grained enough to distinguish what is being done. Behind each step sits a second, finer record: the motion verbs that carry it out— pick , place , move , grasp —46 classes over the motion record, 2.5 per step.
blocks.zh: 动作:99个任务动词. 一个任务动词名称 一个步骤作为一个目标所实现的——擦擦,打开,折叠——是一个计划书写的单位. 词汇在原则上是开放的,但在实践中是紧凑的:99个班次覆盖了步数记录,中间数为每班81次出现,最频繁的十个班次占60.0%。 头部是日常操控——擦,开,折,近,安排——上方是较稀有的动词的长尾,因此同一套词既作为小的标签词汇,又作为描述精细,足以区分正在做的工作. 每一步后面坐着一个更精细的第二段记录:执行它的运动动词——挑,位置,移动,抓住——46个班次超过运动记录,每步2.5个班次.

blocks.en: The tiers treat the vocabulary differently. L3 keeps 40 task verbs (40%), and those verbs cover 77.3% of L1 task occurrences. A protocol fixes the task set, so the verb list contracts to the tasks it scripts, while the steps that are recorded stay labelled in full: the deep tier is selective in vocabulary but not in the record.
blocks.zh: 等级对词汇的处理不同. L3保留了40个任务动词(40%),这些动词涵盖了77.3%的L1任务发生. 一个协议将任务集固定下来,所以动词列表合同与其脚本中的任务,而被记录的步骤则保留了完整的标签:深层在词汇中是选择性的,而不是在记录中.

blocks.en: Object: 635 635 classes. The object side is longer-tailed still: the ten most frequent classes take about 42.5% of the object occurrences, while the median class occurs only about 130 times in total, and the 46 most frequent classes already carry 80% of the record ( Figure 1 f). Coverage again separates the tiers: L1 holds 630 classes and L2 386, while L3 keeps 95 and leaves the other 540 540 absent from L3; those 95 still account for 82.0% of L1 occurrences and 97.3% of L2. L3 is a subset of L2; L2 adds a small probe set of objects absent from L1. The deep tier thus keeps 15% of the vocabulary and more than four fifths of the record—the same contraction seen in the scenes, and for the same reason. \appref app:objects describes the measured object library—its size, weight, material and colour distributions—and how it is counted against this annotation vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 对象:635 635个班级. 物体侧面的尾部仍然较长:最频繁的十个类大约占物体发生次数的42.5%,而中位数类总共只发生约130次,最频繁的46个类已经携带了记录的80%(图1f). 覆盖率再次将各等级分开:L1为630级,L2 386级,L3为95级,其余540 540级为L3;这些95级仍占L1发生率的82.0%,占L2的97.3%。 L3是L2的子集;L2增加了L1缺失的一组小探测器天体. 因此,深层保留了15%的词汇和五分之四以上的记录——与场景中看到的同样收缩,也是出于同样的原因。 \appref app:objects 描述被测量的对象库——它的大小,重量,材料和颜色分布——以及它如何被计算在这个注释词汇上.

blocks.en: Taken together, all three vocabularies are long-tailed, and what the tiers trade is breadth against depth rather than vocabulary size: the shallow tiers spread the full vocabulary over everyday activity, while the deep tier contracts to the classes its protocol needs and concentrates the record there.
blocks.zh: 三个词汇组合在一起,都是长尾的,而分层交易的则是宽度相对于深度,而不是词汇大小:浅层将全部词汇分布在日常活动上,而深层则与分层签约,使其协议需要并集中记录在那里.

blocks.en: 3.5 Inside an Episode
blocks.zh: 3.5 诗集内部

blocks.en: Figure 2 opens one L3 episode in full: the metric scene in Figure 2 a, the camera views and depth map in Figure 2 b, the annotation of the selected step in Figure 2 c, and the task stages with the intent proxies of the same interval in Figure 2 d. It is shown in the controlled L3 setting because that is where the body is instrumented: the gaze, the hands, and the wrists that the other tiers infer from video are measured here.
blocks.zh: 图2全开一集L3:图2a中的度量场景,图2b中的相机视图和深度图,图2c中选定步骤的注释,以及图2d中相同间隔的意向代词的任务阶段. 它被显示在受控的L3设置中,因为这就是身体被仪表的地方: 视线,手,和手腕,从视频中推断出的其他层次在这里被测量.

blocks.en: Geometry. The point cloud is reconstructed from the two front views; the head, both wrists, and the finger joints are placed in one metric frame, so a grasp is located on the object rather than only in the image ( Figure 2 a). In the controlled L3 subset these quantities are measured: three trackers give the head and both wrists, and the gloves give the joints. At L1, at L2, and in the open L3 subset the same quantities are estimated from RGB, with each wrist root anchored in the scene frame through the depth map and the finger joints following in three dimensions. The frame is shared; the evidence behind it is not.
blocks.zh: 几何学. 点云是从两个前视点重建而成;头部,两手腕,手指关节都放在一个度量框中,因此一个抓子位于物体上,而不只是在图像上(图2 a). 在受控的L3子集中,这些量被测量:三个跟踪器给头和两只手腕,手套给关节. 在L1、L2和开放的L3子集中,从RGB中估计出同样数量,每个腕根通过深度图和手指关节按三个维度固定在场景框架。 框架是共享的;其背后的证据不是。

blocks.en: Views. Four egocentric views pair the two front lenses (left-front and right-front) with the left and right views, and at L3 two wrist views add the hands at work ( Figure 2 b). A depth map is reconstructed on demand from the front pair, and in the controlled setting a third-person view records the operator and the desk from outside. The frames are stored as recorded, with no annotation drawn over the pixels.
blocks.zh: 观点。 4个以自我为中心的视角将两个前镜(左前镜和右前镜)与左右视角配对,在L3时两个手腕视角加工作时的手(图2b). 深度图根据前对的需求重建,在控制设置中第三人称视图从外部记录操作员和办公桌. 框按记录保存,没有在像素上绘制注释.

blocks.en: Annotation. The selected instance is shown in Figure 2 c: each step carries a short description, a task verb, the hand that executed it, and the objects it touched, and at L2 and L3 the object record adds a photo, a hex colour, a shape, a material, a weight, and a size given in the parameters its shape calls for (radius and height for a cylinder, for instance). For the step in the panel the atomic action is grasp and the working hand left .
blocks.zh: 注释. 所选实例如图2c所示:每个步骤都包含一个简短的描述,一个任务动词,执行它的手,以及它碰到的物体,在L2和L3上,物体记录增加了一个照片,一个十六进制颜色,一个形状,一个材料,一个重量,以及它的形状要求的大小(例如,一个圆柱的辐射和高度). 对于板块中的步骤,原子行动是抓住的,而工作手是留下的。

blocks.en: Intent proxies. Each episode is cut into stages, shown as the strip at the top of Figure 2 d. The three traces beneath the strip are the proxies for the state z z that the action is about to express, and each is read as a lead or a lag against the action it announces. Gaze is the eye’s ( x , y ) (x,y) position, measured by the eye tracker in the pixels of its scene camera in the controlled L3 subset and estimated from the rectified head view at L1, at L2, and in the open L3 subset: the eye reaches the object before the hand does, so the trace externalises the target of the next reach—a fixation is a flat stretch, a saccade a near-vertical step, and the moment the eye settles marks what the hand is about to act on ( m gaze m_{\text{gaze}} ). EMG is eight envelope traces per forearm, flat at rest and rising before contact: the forearm loads grip force to the weight the hand expects, so a burst records the force the operator intends to apply, not only the force applied when the fingers close ( m emg m_{\text{emg}} ). EEG is a stack of channel traces, three orders of magnitude below EMG and drawn on its own scale: the slow build before the movement and the sharp response after an error are the cortical preparation and the outcome check, read as deviations from the ongoing rhythm rather than as spikes ( m eeg m_{\text{eeg}} ). On one clock, the three answer what the instant means—where the operator is about to reach, how hard they expect to grip, and what was decided before the hand moved.
blocks.zh: 意意亲者. 每集被切成阶段,显示为图2d顶部的条状. 条条下方的三个痕迹是动作即将表达的状态z z的代理,每个被读作领先或与它宣布的行动相对的滞后. Gaze是眼睛(x,y) (x,y) 位置,由眼睛跟踪器在其场景相机的像素中测量在受控的L3子集中,并且从L1, L2的纠正头视图中估计,在开放的L3子集中:眼睛在手前到达物体,因此微量的外部化了下一个伸展的目标——一个固定是平坦的伸展,一个圣杯是近垂直的一步,眼定下来的瞬间标志着手要做什么(m 凝视 m_{\tex{gaze}}). EMG是每个前臂的8个信封痕迹,平坦休息,并在接触前上升:前臂负载的牵引力达到手预期的重量,所以一个爆破记录了操作员打算施加的力,而不只是手指关闭时施加的力(m emg m_{\text{emg}}}). EEG是一叠通道痕迹,在EMG以下有三个数量级,并按自己的比例绘制:运动前的缓慢构建和错误后的尖锐反应是皮质准备和结果检查,读作偏离正在进行的节奏,而不是尖锐(meg m_{\text{eeg}}}). 在一个钟点上,三个回答瞬间的含义——操作员即将到达的地方,他们期望抓住多少困难,以及手动前所决定的是什么.

blocks.en: An episode is therefore one record aligned to a common time base and in a single frame: the views and the point cloud give the scene, the poses, joint angles, and gaze give the body’s place in it, EMG and EEG give the exertion and the cortical preparation behind the movement, and the annotation gives each step its place in the task.
blocks.zh: 因此,一个剧集就是一个与共同时间基数一致的纪录,在一个单一的框中:观点和点云给出了场景,姿势,关节角,和凝视给出了身体在其中的位置,EMG和EEG给出了运动背后的锻炼和皮质准备,注释给出了每一个步骤在任务中的位置.

EgoBrain is a complement rather than a replacement. It has already shown that
cortex can be recorded on the first-person timeline, but does so in a controlled,
seated, scripted setting, trading breadth for signal density: 61 hours, 40

at L3. What it adds is two things EgoBrain does not attempt: gaze and surface EMG

This subsection is organised by proxy rather than by device: the instruments a

blocks.en: 4.2 Settings and Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2 设置和协议

blocks.en: A tier’s collection is governed by two requirements: how much of the everyday scene it must preserve, and how much signal fidelity its instrumentation demands. The two pull in opposite directions, and the corpus resolves them tier by tier.
blocks.zh: 分级收集有两项要求:它必须保存多少日常场景,以及它的仪表要求多少信号忠贞。 两者向相反的方向拉动, 和本体解决它们 逐级。

blocks.en: Two settings. L1 and L2 privilege mobility over signal depth. Every instrument they add is wearable and connects to a headband-mounted computer, so the operator moves through everyday environments—standing, turning, walking, and gesturing—without a fixed bench or cable constraints. This is the open setting: L1 and L2 are collected in it throughout, and L3 also uses it, with a lighter configuration, trading EEG density for scene coverage. Open here names the acquisition setting, not the task: an open-setting session can still use a scripted task sheet and a staged scene.
blocks.zh: 两个设置。 L1和L2在信号深度上特权移动. 他们添加的每台仪器都可以穿戴,并连接到头带式计算机上,因此操作员通过日常环境——站立、转弯、步行和游览——移动时没有固定的长凳或电缆限制。 这就是开放的设置:L1和L2在其中被收集到整个过程,L3也使用它,其配置更轻,交易EEG密度进行场景覆盖. 在此打开获取设置的名称, 而不是任务 : 打开设定会话仍然可以使用一个脚本任务表和一个舞台场景 。

blocks.en: L3 is where the trade-off reverses. Dense electrophysiology requires a stable posture: electrode contact and impedance degrade with movement, and the denser the recording, the less it tolerates motion. The eye tracker, the gloves, and the wrist trackers load the same platform, so acquisition calls for a bench that does not move. Sessions run in short blocks, with a re-baseline between blocks to limit drift. L3 is collected under both settings: in the controlled setting the amplifier and the host remain on a dedicated desk and the operator holds still, and the session runs imagery then execution; in the open setting the kit runs on the headband computer in everyday scenes, and the session runs execution only.
blocks.zh: L3是取舍倒置的地方. 敏捷的电生理学需要稳定的姿势:电极接触和阻力随运动而降解,录音的密度越大,就越不能容忍运动. 眼追踪器,手套,手腕追踪器都装上了相同的平台,因此收购要求有一个不会移动的长凳. 会话以短块形式运行,区块之间有一个重基线来限制漂移. L3是在两种设置下收集的:在受控设置中放大器和主机留在专用台上,操作员保持静止,会话运行图像然后执行;在开放设置中,套件运行在日常场景的头带计算机上,会话仅运行执行.

(b) Execution (green screen): the same operator manipulates the objects, head held as still as the grasp allows. The eyes move in both phases, the hands only in the second.

blocks.en: The two cued phases of a controlled session (e.g., pick up the cup ). (a) Imagery (blue screen): the operator sits still, hands on the desk, and rehearses the task with only EEG and gaze recorded. (b) Execution (green screen): the same operator manipulates the objects, head held as still as the grasp allows. The eyes move in both phases, the hands only in the second.
blocks.zh: 控制会话的两个提示阶段(例如拿起杯子). (a) 图像(蓝屏):操作员静坐,手放在桌子上,排练任务时只录制EEG和凝视。 (b) 执行(绿色屏幕):同一操作员操纵物体,头部按住,只要抓住允许。 眼睛分两个阶段移动,双手只在第二个阶段.

blocks.en:
Imagery, then execution. The controlled setting also carries the paradigm that makes the EEG informative, built around the high-density record. Imagery is confined to this setting for two reasons: its boundaries are delimited by phase markers that the experimenter records during the session, and the preparatory signal is low in amplitude and spatially structured, so only the dense array separates it from noise. Preparation and motor imagery are brief and are easily masked by the movement that follows, so the session separates imagery from execution ( Section 4.2 ). In the imagery phase ( Section 4.2 a) the screen turns blue: the operator faces it, sits still, and rehearses the task sequence without moving, so that motor imagery and preparatory EEG are recorded free of movement artefact; gaze is recorded as well, so that the scanpath of the plan can be read off. In the execution phase ( Section 4.2 b) the screen turns green: the same operator manipulates the objects on the desk, and every modality is recorded, so that the EEG and the other streams can be read against the actual movement.
Every transition is also written to the record as a marker—run start, imagine start, execute start, and run end—so that the phases can be cut out of any stream on a common time base rather than by hand.
blocks.zh:
图像,然后执行。 控制设置还带有使EEG信息化的范式,围绕高密度记录构建. 图像学仅限于此设定有两个原因:它的边界被实验者在会话中记录的相位标记所划分,预备信号在振幅和空间结构上都很低,因此只有密集的阵列将其与噪音区分开来. 制备和运动图像简短,很容易被随后的运动掩盖,因此会议将图像与执行分开(第4.2节)。 在图像阶段(第4.2a节),屏幕变为蓝色:操作员面对它,静坐,不动地排练任务序列,这样,运动图像和预置的EEG就可以无动于衷地记录动脉动脉;视线也被记录下来,这样就可以读取计划的扫描路径. 在执行阶段(第4.2b节),屏幕变绿色:同一个操作员操纵桌面上的对象,并记录每一种方式,这样可以对照实际运动来读取EEG和其他流.
每一个过渡也都写到记录中,作为一个标记——运行的开始,想象开始,执行开始,运行的结束——这样,各个阶段就可以在一个共同的时基上从任何流中切除,而不是用手切除.

blocks.en: Each controlled episode therefore comprises three segments, not two cues alone: preparation while the operator settles, imagery of the task sequence, and execution of that sequence. Because the first two are acquired while the body is still, the EEG records the task as it is planned rather than as it is performed: the step sequence and the action each step will require, with no movement to mask them. The high-density record exists for that pairing: the same task as a plan, acquired while the body is still, and as a performance seconds later. Open settings (L1, L2, and L3 with the lighter configuration) record the execution segment alone.
blocks.zh: 因此,每个受控插曲由三个部分组成,而不只是两个提示:在操作员结算时的准备、任务序列的图像以及该序列的执行。 因为前两步是在身体静止时获得的,EEG记录了任务按计划而非执行:步序和每步需要的动作,没有移动来掩盖它们. 高密度记录存在于该配对中: 任务与计划相同,在机体静止时获得,作为性能秒后. 打开设置(L1,L2和L3带有较轻的配置)单独记录执行部分.

blocks.en: Collection procedure. L1 is recorded without guidance: operators are asked only to carry out the activity as they normally would. L2 and L3 use task sheets: the operator arranges the objects as drawn and follows the step order marked on the sheet, so that the same task is staged identically across sessions. At L3, tasks are drawn in random order rather than blocked, which sustains engagement and limits drift of the EEG towards drowsiness. Operators also rotate between scenes at a fixed interval, so that no operator works a single scene for an entire shift and no scene is shaped by an individual’s habits.
blocks.zh: 收集程序。 L1在没有指导的情况下被记录下来:操作者只被要求按照正常情况进行活动. L2和L3使用任务表:操作员按绘制的对象进行排列,并遵循工作表上标注的步令,这样同一任务在会话中同样进行. 在L3中,任务按随机顺序抽取,而不是屏蔽,这维持了接触,限制了EEG向昏暗方向的漂移. 操作员也会在固定的间隔间进行场景之间的旋转,这样,任何操作员都会为整班工作一个场景,任何场景都不会由个人的习惯所塑造.

blocks.en: All operators are trained to a single standard before collection: how to wear each device, how to run a session, and how to record it. L3 adds two requirements: operators are trained to keep the head still during acquisition and are responsible for seating and maintaining the electrodes so that contact quality stays within range; participants assigned to L3 are also screened so that the EEG is clear and stable. Each hour of collection is followed by fifteen minutes of rest, to sustain attention and energy.
blocks.zh: 所有操作员在收集前都经过单一标准的培训:如何穿戴每个设备,如何运行一个会话,以及如何记录. L3增加了两项要求:操作员在获取过程中接受保持头部的训练,并负责座椅和维护电极,以便接触质量保持在范围内;被分配到L3的参与者也经过筛选,以便EEG清晰稳定. 收集后每小时休息15分钟,以保持注意力和精力.

blocks.en: 4.3 Data Storage
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 数据存储

blocks.en: Streams are stored as recorded and linked by reference, never merged into a single file. Each device keeps its own clock, its own native sampling rate, and its own coordinate frame; forcing them into one stream would discard the timing the corpus exists to keep. Synchronization is therefore a property the data declares rather than one it enforces: no resampling and no alignment happen at write time, and the corpus is written as many asynchronous files, each at its own rate.
blocks.zh: 流被存储为记录和以参考方式链接,从未合并成一个文件. 每个设备都保留自己的时钟,自己的本地采样率,以及自己的坐标架;强迫它们进入一条溪流会丢弃本设备所保持的时间。 因此,同步是数据所宣布的财产,而不是它所执行的财产:在写作时不进行重印和对齐,并且本体是像许多同步文件一样的,每个文件按自己的速率编写.

blocks.en: At write time, every episode keeps one Parquet table per modality ( Figure 4 a), one file per observation stream: the camera views, EEG, gaze, hand pose, glove skeleton, three device poses (head and both wrists), head and wrist IMUs, and wrist EMG. videos/ holds one encoded video per camera view, calibrations/ holds the rectification parameters and the manifest, annotation/ the structured annotation and the QC verdict, and meta/ the episode metadata with its alignment and statistics reports. Every sample is stamped relative to the start of the recording, and that difference is stored as given, not snapped to a master frame, so non-uniform intervals and device jitter survive into the file. The complete directory layout is in \appref app:layout.
blocks.zh: 在写作时间,每集每个模式保存一个Parquet表(图4a),每个观察流保存一个文件:相机视图,EEG,凝视,手姿,手套骨架,三个设备姿势(头和手腕),头和手腕IMU,以及腕部EMG. 视频/持有每台相机视图一个编码视频,校准/持有校正参数和标注,注释/结构化注释和QC判断,元数据/集元数据及其对齐和统计报告. 每个样本都会相对于录制的开始被盖上印章,这种差异会按给定的存储,而不是被压缩到主框上,因此非统一间隔和器件抖动在文件中生存. 完整的目录布局在\appref app:layout中.

blocks.en: Quality is enforced on the recording, not on the downstream analysis. Every session is checked stream by stream once it is written—dropped or out-of-order samples, black or frozen video, dead channels, impossible value jumps, a device missing from the set—and a session that fails is recaptured rather than repaired, so a released episode never mixes a good half with a patched one. The verdicts travel with the episode in its metadata; \appref app:qc lists the checks, their thresholds, and what each level costs.
blocks.zh: 质量在记录上执行,而不是在下游分析上执行. 每个会话一旦被写成 - 滴放或序外的样本, 黑色或冷冻的视频, 死亡的通道, 无法的值跳动, 设备在设定中缺失 - 失败的会话会被重拾而不是修复, 因此发布的插曲从不与补丁混合 。 判决与该插曲一起在其元数据中进行;\appref app:qc 列出检查,其阈值,以及每个关卡的成本.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : One episode on disk, and how it is read. (a) One Parquet file per stream, each a timestamp column plus data columns, beside a master index. (b) Timestamps are relative to the start of the recording, so no feature sits on a fixed grid; a query fixes a master rate and resolves each feature from its own timestamps. Every camera appears twice under videos/ , once raw and once rectified, except the depth view, which is rectified only.
blocks.zh: 图4:一张磁盘上的插曲,如何读取. (a) 每流一个Parquet文件,每个时间戳栏加上数据栏,旁边有一个主索引。 (b) 时间戳与录音的开始相对,因此没有特性坐落在固定的网格上;查询会固定主速率,并从自己的时间戳中解决每个特性. 每个相机在视频/ 下出现两次,一次是原始的,一次是修正的,除了深度视图,它只是修正的.

blocks.en: Reading is fully decoupled from writing. A separate master-index file is sampled at a fixed rate, and the reader chooses that rate (30 fps by default); a master frame then indexes every modality through its own timestamps, resolved by nearest sample, interpolation, or all samples in a window such as ( − 1 / FPS , 0 ] (-1/\mathrm{FPS},\,0] ( Figure 4 b). The format is a modification of LeRobot [ cadene2024lerobot ] and remains compatible with it: installing pip install humancoin is enough to preview, download, and use the data, and the acquisition software and the documentation are released alongside it 1 1 1 https://github.com/FlagOpen/HumanCOIN .
blocks.zh: 阅读与写作完全脱钩. 一个单独的主索引文件以固定的速率进行采样,阅读器选择这个速率(默认为30英尺);一个主帧然后通过自己的时间戳来索引每个模式,通过最近的样本,插图,或者所有样本在窗口中解决,如(− 1 / FPS, 0)] (-1/\mathrm{FPS},\,0) (图4 b). 该格式是对LeRobot [cadene2024lerobot]的修改,并保持兼容性:安装 pip 安装人币足以预览,下载和使用数据,并同时发布获取软件和文件 https://github.com/FlagOpen/HumanCOIN 。 。 。

blocks.en: 5 Data Processing
blocks.zh: 页:1 数据处理

blocks.en: Processing runs per stream, because the noise and the failure modes of each modality are set by its own measurement physics; the streams meet only at the end ( Figure 5 ). Each stream is reduced to a timestamp, a unit, a declared frame, and an alignment report, and the five groups follow the dependency order of the data—synchronization and calibration, geometry and motion, gaze, electrophysiology—with annotation last, since it consumes the others. Chains are fixed, their parameters are logged per episode, and a failing step is flagged rather than filled, so any run can be replayed.
blocks.zh: 处理每流运行,因为每种模式的噪声和故障模式是由其自身的测量物理设定的;流只在结尾处相会(图5 ). 每条流都减少到一个时间戳、一个单位、一个宣布的框架和一份对齐报告,这五个组按照数据(同步和校准、几何和运动、凝视、电生理学)的依赖顺序,最后加上注释,因为它消耗了其他数据。 链条固定,每集记录其参数,并标出一个失败的步号而不是填充,因此任何运行都可以重播.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Processing pipeline. Each stream enters the group that handles its physics: synchronization and calibration (clock offsets, camera intrinsics, eye calibration); geometry and motion (stereo depth from FoundationStereo, point cloud, 6-DoF poses with finger joints, hand reconstruction from the rectified front view); gaze (acquisition at L3, prediction at L1 and L2); and electrophysiology (band-pass filtering, notch, bad-channel interpolation). The groups then align to a common time base and pass through annotation before an episode is written.
blocks.zh: 图5:处理管道。 每条流进入处理其物理的组:同步与校准(时钟偏移,相机内在,视线校准);几何与运动(FoundationStereo的立体深度,点云,6-DoF的姿势有指关节,从修正的前视线进行手部重建);凝视(L3的获取,L1和L2的预测);以及电生(波段滤波,noch,坏通道内插). 剧组随后与共同的时间基数对齐,并在剧集编剧前经过注释.

blocks.en: 5.1 Synchronization and Calibration
blocks.zh: 5.1 同步和校准

blocks.en:
We use soft synchronization. The recorder stamps every sample relative to the start of the recording, and the sync host records arrival offsets for the streams that share a transport; the two together place each sample on a common time base without resampling. A per-stream audit of released L3 episodes is reported in \appref app:sync: the high-rate streams align below one sample period, while the 30 Hz cameras are frame-quantized. Calibration (intrinsics and distortion for every camera, the tracker-to-frame transform, and the eye-tracker calibration) ships with the episode in calibrations/ , alongside both encodings of
every camera, so a reader can re-derive the geometry rather than accept the
undistortion applied at write time. Because neither offsets nor calibrations are applied at write time, a reader can align at any custom rate and choose nearest sample, interpolation, or a window. Residuals between the chosen rate and the samples actually read are written to the per-episode alignment report, so a downstream analysis can audit the timing it inherited.
blocks.zh:
我们使用软同步。 记录器在与录制开始相关的每个样本上盖章,同步主机记录的到来抵消了共享传输的溪流;两者合在一起将每个样本放在一个共同的时间基上,而不进行复制. 在\appref app:sync中报告了对已发布的L3集的每流审计:高速率流在一个样本期以下对齐,而30Hz相机则被帧定量. 校准(每台相机的内装和失真,跟踪器对帧的变换,以及眼跟踪器的校准)
每台相机,一个读取器可以重构几何,而不是接受
在写作时应用了分解. 由于在写时既不应用抵消,也不应用校准,因此一个阅读器可以任意自定义速率对齐,并选择最近的样本,插值,或者一个窗口. 所选比率与实际读取的样本之间的残余物写成每集校正报告,因此下游分析可以审计它继承的时间.

blocks.en: 5.2 Geometry and Motion
blocks.zh: 5.2 几何和运动

blocks.en: Depth is built from RGB. The left-front and right-front lenses are hardware-timestamp synchronized, so every stereo pair comes from the same instant; the pair, together with the camera parameters, is passed to FoundationStereo [ wen2025foundationstereo ] , which returns a depth map stored with the intrinsics that produced it. Point clouds are formed per frame by projecting depth through those intrinsics and are subsampled to a fixed budget.
blocks.zh: 深度由RGB构建. 左前方和右前方的镜头是硬件-时间戳同步的,因此每个立体对都来自同一瞬间;对子与相机参数一起传递给FoundationStereo [wen2025foundationstereo],它返回了存储着产生它的内在的深度图. 点云是通过通过这些内在的投影深度形成每个框架的,并被取样为固定预算。

blocks.en: Motion follows the same route. In the controlled L3 subset three 6-DoF trackers give the head and both wrists directly ( ∼ \sim 800 Hz, millimetres, one shared frame), and the gloves give 20 joint angles per hand ( ∼ \sim 800 Hz, degrees). At L1, at L2, and in the open L3 subset both hands are reconstructed from video over each continuous segment: the model builds on ACE-Ego-Hand [ liu2026aceegohand ] and takes clean-latent features from Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control [ videoxfun2026 , wan2025 ] , and a bidirectional spatiotemporal decoder returns, for every frame, the two wrists and the finger joints in the camera frame, MANO shape and articulation, wrist translation, the intrinsics it assumed, and two confidence fields per hand---whether it is present, and how much of it is visible. 2 2 2 The model was developed by the authors and is described in full in the accompanying report [ innata2026 ] .
blocks.zh: 动议遵循同样的路线。 在受控的L3子集中,3个6-DoF跟踪器直接给出头部和两个手腕(\\sim 800 Hz,毫米,一个共享框),手套给出每手20关节角(\\sim 800 Hz,度). 在L1,在L2,在开放的L3子集中,两只手都是从视频中重建出来的,覆盖在每个连续段:模型以ACE-Ego-Hand [liu2026aceegohand]为基础,取Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control[视频xfun2026,wan2025]的清淡特性,以及双向spatiental解码器返回,每个帧,相机框中的两只手腕和手指关节,MANO形状和表达,腕部翻译,它所假设的内在,以及每个手-是否存在两个信任字段,以及它有多少可见. 2个 2个 2 该模型由作者开发,并在所附报告[innata2026]中作了全面描述。

blocks.en: Before reconstruction, the main view of every unit is rectified to a common pinhole domain, the intrinsics are updated after cropping and resizing, and the analytic rays are generated from the updated intrinsics; a unit’s declared calibration is used where it exists, and the pinhole parameters are predicted from the features where it does not. The intrinsics released with the track are those of this domain, not those of the raw lens. Overlapping windows are fused at their source timestamps: rotations combine in rotation space, one shape per hand and one camera per segment are fixed, and the geometry is regenerated, so that shape and scale do not drift as the visible part of the hand changes—what a user reads is a hand that keeps its size through a grasp. The output is already three-dimensional in the camera frame, so only the wrist root has to be anchored: its pixel is looked up in the depth map and back-projected, and the finger joints, three-dimensional relative to that root, ride along. The depth map remains the metric reference for the scene and the objects. In the controlled L3 subset the same fields are measured rather than inferred, which is what makes that record the reference against which the reconstruction is scored. All poses (head, both hands, hand kinematics) and the environment point cloud are mapped into one unified coordinate frame.
blocks.zh: 在重建前,每个单元的主要视野被修正到一个常见的针孔域,内在元素在裁剪和再大小后更新,分析射线由更新的内在元素产生;一个单元的申报校准在存在的地方使用,针孔参数是从没有的特征中预测出来的. 随音轨释放的内在元素是这个域的,而不是原始镜头的. 重叠的窗口在其源时间戳上被引信:旋转结合在旋转空间中,每手一个形状和每段一个相机固定,再生成几何,这样形状和尺度不会随着手的可见部分的改变而漂移——一个用户读到的是一个通过抓取来保持其大小的手. 输出在相机框中已经是三维的,所以只有手腕根必须锚定:它的像素在深度图中向上看并反投影,手指关节,相对于那个根的三维,骑着走. 深度图仍然是场景和物体的参数参考. 在控制的L3子集中,同样的字段是测量的,而不是推断的,因此记录了重建的参照。 所有姿势(头,双手,手动)和环境点云被映射成一个统一的坐标框.

blocks.en: 5.3 Gaze
blocks.zh: 5.3 盖兹

blocks.en: Gaze is obtained by acquisition and by estimation. Both routes write the same fields—a timestamp and a pixel coordinate—in the pixels of the image each route reads: the scene camera of the eye tracker in the controlled L3 subset, the rectified head view at L1, at L2, and in the open L3 subset.
blocks.zh: 盖兹是通过收购和估算获得的. 两条路由在图像的像素上都写着相同的字段——一个时间戳和一个像素坐标——每个路由都写着:受控L3子集中眼睛跟踪器的场景摄像头,L1,L2,以及开放的L3子集中的修正头视图.

blocks.en: In the controlled L3 subset the eye tracker is calibrated per participant and per session and logs at 200 Hz; its coordinates are pixels of the scene-camera image, whose video runs at 30 fps. The calibration that produced each record—the intrinsics and distortion of that camera, with the transform that carries a ray into the head frame—ships with the episode, so a pixel can be back-projected and placed in the head frame. Because L3 records a reference measurement, it also serves as the test bed for the estimator used at L1 and L2.
blocks.zh: 在控制的L3子集中,眼睛跟踪器按每个参与者和每个会话和日志校准200赫兹;其坐标为场景-相机图像的像素,其视频运行时间为30英尺. 制作每张唱片的校准——那台相机的内在和扭曲,以及将一束射线带入头框的变形——与剧集的飞船,所以一个像素可以反射,放在头框中. 由于L3记录了参考度量,它也作为L1和L2所使用的估计器的测试床.

blocks.en: Outside that subset there is no eye tracker—at L1, at L2, and in the open L3 subset—and the gaze point is predicted by a pipeline built on EgoM2P [ li2025egom2p ] that runs from video to coordinates. It reads the unit’s rectified left-front view, where the unit provides one—left not because it is more accurate, but because rectification, depth, hands, and annotation all use that view, so cross-modal alignment needs no extra transform—under the model’s fixed input specification: a 2 s window, 16 frames, and a 256 × 256 256\times 256 input. The gaze points of a window are predicted and then linearly resampled to the window’s frame count, so that every frame carries exactly one row; a tail shorter than a window is covered by an additional window aligned to the end of the video, so that the prediction is as long as the video. The output is fixed at 30 Hz and is not interpolated to L3’s 200 Hz: the model’s positional encoding fixes 30 tokens per second, and interpolation would only manufacture precision. The difference ships with the column, and a user who wants another rate can resample. Coordinates are pixels of the video: the model works inside a fixed 256 × 256 256\times 256 centre crop, and the pipeline maps its output back, so that a released coordinate indexes the frame a user has rather than a position inside the model’s input. The prediction is written as a table isomorphic to L3’s but registered under a separate feature name, so that measurement and estimate cannot be confused.
blocks.zh: 在该子集之外,L1、L2和L3的开放式子集没有眼睛跟踪器,视点是通过从视频到坐标的EgoM2P[li2025egom2p]上建造的管道预测的。 它读到该单元纠正的左前方视图,其中单元提供左后方不是因为它更准确,而是因为校正、深度、手和注释都使用了该视图,因此跨模式对齐不需要额外的转换——在模型的固定输入规格下:一个2s窗口,16帧,以及256×256\时256输入。 视窗的视点是预测的,然后线性地复制到视窗的帧数上,这样每个帧都精确地搭载一行;一个比窗口短的尾巴被一个额外的窗口覆盖,与视频的结尾对齐,这样预测就和视频一样长. 输出定在30赫兹,不插入L3的200赫兹:该模型的位置编码每秒固定30个令牌,插入只会制造精度. 与列的区别船,一个想要另一种速率的用户可以重现. 坐标是视频的像素:模型在固定的256×256\times 256中心作物内工作,管道绘制出其输出回图,这样一个释放的坐标索引一个用户的帧而不是模型输入内的位置. 预测作为L3的同位素表写成,但以单独的特征名称注册,因此测量和估计不能混淆.

blocks.en: 5.4 Electrophysiology
blocks.zh: 5.4 大理动物生物学

blocks.en: Both streams are cleaned with a fixed chain. EMG is filtered in zero phase and reduced to an envelope. The trace is mirror-padded at both ends, band-passed between 20 and 450 Hz with second- and fourth-order Butterworth sections applied forward and backward, and comb-notched at 50 Hz with a 2 Hz bandwidth, with periodic extension and period alignment at the edges so that the notch does not ring there. The cleaned trace is rectified and reduced to one envelope per channel, and the raw trace is kept beside it as *_emg_raw . \appref app:ephys lists the orders, cut-offs, and padding steps.
blocks.zh: 两条溪流都用固定的链条清理. EMG在零相中过滤,并缩小为信封. 微量是两端的镜插,带宽在20至450赫兹之间,带有二阶和四阶的巴特沃思路段向前和向后应用,梳理为50赫兹,带宽为2赫兹,边缘有定期的延长和周期对齐,以使 Notch在那里不响. 被清理的痕迹被修正, 并缩小为每个通道一个信封, 原始的痕迹被保存在它的旁边 \ emg_raw 。 \appref app: ephys 列出命令, 截断, 和绑定步骤 。

blocks.en: EEG passes through seven. The channel is de-meaned, band-passed between 0.5 and 100 Hz with the high cut held below Nyquist, and notched at 50 Hz, which keeps the delta-to-gamma range in which motor-imagery and error-related potentials live. Bad channels are flagged by five joint rules—flat, electrode contact, bridging between neighbours, decorrelation from the rest of the montage, and high-frequency noise—and a session passes only when fewer than 30% of its channels are flagged. An infomax ICA fitted once on the clean segments of a session removes ocular components, selected by correlation with the frontal channels, and muscle components, selected by their power above 30 Hz. Flagged channels are then interpolated by spherical spline over the retained ones, and the cleaned trace is re-referenced to their average. The stages are released as separate tables— eeg_raw as acquired, eeg filtered, and eeg_repair after interpolation and component removal. \appref app:ephys gives the rule thresholds, the component criteria, and the electrode positions that lack a conventional coordinate.
blocks.zh: EEG通过7。 该频道被贬低,带宽在0.5至100赫兹之间,在Nyquist下方持有高切数,在50赫兹时注音,这保持了运动成像和与错误有关的潜力存在的三角形至伽马范围. 5条共同规则标出了坏的频道——平面、电极接触、邻居之间的桥梁、与蒙太基其余部分的装饰关系以及高频噪音——而且只有标出不到30%的频道才通过一个会话。 一次安装在会话干净部分的Infomax ICA会清除与前导通道相关联选择的视光元件,以及肌肉元件,由它们超过30Hz的功率选择. 标记的通道再通过球状的丝状线插在保留通道上,被清除的痕迹会重新参照它们的平均值. 各个阶段作为单独的表格发布——eeg_raw as addressed,eeg过滤,在插件和组件清除后eeg_修复. \appref app:ephys给出了规则阈值,组件标准,以及缺乏常规坐标的电极位置.

blocks.en: Motion cannot be removed from a recording in which the operator moves, and even the deepest tier is stationary only by protocol ( Section 4.2 ). The cleaned EEG is therefore signal plus residual motion noise: we release the metrics that bound it—impedance pass rate, share of interpolated channels, and share of samples marked artefactual—and leave the choice of a stricter rejection threshold to the user. EMG is recorded at 2000 Hz in millivolts, eight channels per arm; EEG at 1000 Hz over 128 saline channels or at 250 Hz over 32 or 8 gel channels, in microvolts, with every channel named by brain region and its impedance logged in kilohms as a quality input.
blocks.zh: 从操作员移动的录音中无法删除动议,甚至最深的一层也只能通过协议固定(第4.2节)。 因此,清洁的EEG是信号加剩余运动噪声:我们释放了约束它的指标——障碍通过率、插孔通道份额和标有动脉的样品份额——并留给用户选择更严格的拒绝门槛。 环境管理小组的记录为2000年。 Hz在millivolts,每臂8个通道;EEG在1000赫兹超过128个盐碱通道,或250赫兹超过32或8个胶质通道,在微压中,每个通道按脑区域命名,其阻力以千米记录为质量输入.

blocks.en: 5.5 Annotation and Segmentation
blocks.zh: 5.5 注释和分区

blocks.en: Every episode is annotated at the level of task steps ( Figure 2 c): temporally bounded segments carrying the step sentence, the action it names, the hand in use, and every object the sentence reaches. Annotation is produced with Argus [ argus2026 ] , an open-source harness for dense annotation of robot-learning data, running on top of Qwen3.8-27B [ qwen2026qwen38 ] . Argus reasons jointly over video, state, and sensor evidence to produce dense labels: action phases, subgoals, key events, outcomes, operator mistakes and recoveries, and object-state changes, each with an execution and outcome score and with the evidence and confidence behind it. It exports the labels as JSON and as LeRobot language columns, and a human reviewer checks every export before it enters the release. Objects are not mere name strings: for L2 and L3 every object recorded in an episode’s object list was measured for size and weight, and the measurement is linked to the object instances appearing in each trajectory. Collective references (“the cups”) are expanded to their member objects, and hand-in-use is read from wrist-tracker displacement inside the step window when no explicit label exists.
blocks.zh: 每集在任务步骤级别上附加注释(图2c): 带有步句的按时限定的段段,它命名的动作,手的使用,以及句子到达的每个对象. 注释与Argus[argus2026]一同制作,这是用于密集注释机器人学习数据的开源控制器,运行在Qwen3.8-27B [qwen2026qwen38]上方. 以视频、状态和传感器证据联合提出理由,以产生密集的标签:行动阶段、次级目标、关键事件、结果、操作员错误和复原、以及对象状态变化,每个过程都有执行和结果的分数以及背后的证据和信心。 它输出标签为JSON和LeRobot语言列,在进入发行前,一个人文审查员检查每个出口. 对象不仅仅是名称字符串:对于L2和L3来说,一个集对象列表中记录的每个对象都是按大小和重量来测量的,测量与每个轨迹中出现的对象实例相连. 集体参考(“杯子”)被扩展为成员对象,在没有明确标签的情况下从步窗内的手腕跟踪器移位读取。

blocks.en: L1 needs a different route. Because passive collection does not intervene, a raw L1 recording is one continuous stream that lasts hours, and episodes are cut after the fact: frames and the available annotation are passed to a VLM, which proposes episode boundaries and step segments, and a human reviewer confirms or adjusts every boundary before release. This is why L1 episodes vary widely in length while controlled L3 sessions are scripted, and why an L1 boundary carries the uncertainty of a segmentation rather than the certainty of a cue.
blocks.zh: L1需要不同的路线. 由于被动收集不干预,一个原始的L1录制是一个持续数小时的连续流,事件在事实之后被剪切:帧和可用的注释被传递给一个VLM,它提出插曲边界和步段,而人文评论员在发布前确认或调整每一个边界. 这就是为什么L1事件在长度上差异很大,而控制下的L3会话则被脚本化,为什么一个L1边界带有分区的不确定性而不是提示的确定性.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: An egocentric corpus pairs an observation with an action and so answers what happened; why the action took that form belongs to the intent that preceded it, which is often settled before execution. HumanCOIN collects that intent, recording proxies for it at three signal depths. Whether it holds up depends on work we have not done; we state its limitations first, its openings second.
blocks.zh: 以自我为中心的实体将观察与行动联系起来,从而回答所发生的事情;为什么这一行动形式属于其之前的意图,而这种意图往往是在执行之前就解决的。 HumanCOIN收集这种意图,在3个信号深度记录它的代理. 它是否维持下去,取决于我们尚未做的工作;我们首先说明其局限性,其次是开场。

blocks.en: 6.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.1 限制

blocks.en: The premise is untested. That intent sits between observation and action and carries information the observation does not is untested here: the corpus only makes it testable, and policy training, lead-time baselines, and cross-site quality gates lie outside its scope. Nor can the opposite be excluded: intent may be redundant with observation, since gaze is predictable from the scene and preparatory EEG may follow the kinematics. What fails then is not the concept but the proxies; the negative result turns “is intent redundant?” from a position into a measurement.
blocks.zh: 前提未试. 这种意图介于观察与行动之间,并载有观察所不经过检验的信息:这种程序只是使其可以检验,政策培训、筹备时间基线和跨地点质量门也超出其范围。 也不能排除相反的情况:意图可能与观察是多余的,因为从现场可以预见到目光,而准备的EEG可能跟随动因子. 那么,失败的不是概念,而是代理人;负面结果将“意图多余”从一个位置变为衡量。

blocks.en: Coverage and representativeness. L3 accounts for 4% of the hours (500 h); its controlled subset is about 350 h (2.8%) and is the part concentrated on the desk, and electrode stability bounds how long the densest episodes can run. The scene and task mix is not a random sample of manipulation. L1 is assembled from fourteen heterogeneous units whose camera counts, resolutions, calibration, and declared frames differ ( \appref app:l1audit), so how much of an L1 statistic reflects behaviour rather than the device mix cannot yet be separated.
blocks.zh: 覆盖面和代表性。 L3占时数的4%(500h);其控制的子集约350h(2.8%),是集中在桌上的部分,电极稳定性决定了最密集的集能运行的时间. 场景和任务组合并不是随机的操纵样本. L1是由相机计数,分辨率,校准,以及声明的帧(\appref app:l1audit)的14个不同单元组装而成,因此L1统计中有多少反映了行为而不是设备组合,目前无法分离.

blocks.en: Annotation and comparability. Step boundaries and object attributes are human judgements—L1 boundaries from automatic segmentation with human review, attributes measured only at L2 and L3. Hand motion is estimated at L1, at L2, and in the open L3 subset and measured in the controlled L3 subset, so the estimated part carries a reconstruction error. Comparability holds only in part: timestamps, units, frames, and calibration are released as each source declares them and the declarations are uneven, while quality metrics such as the impedance pass rate exist only at L3.
blocks.zh: 注释和可比性。 阶梯边界和对象属性是人类的判断——L1边界从自动分解与人类检讨,属性仅以L2和L3计量. 手动估计值为L1,在L2,在开放的L3子集中,并在受控的L3子集中进行测量,因此估计的部分带有重建错误. 可比较性仅部分存在:时间戳、单位、帧和校准随着每个来源的宣布而发布,声明不均,而阻碍通过率等质量衡量标准仅存在于L3。

blocks.en: Long tails. The vocabularies are long-tailed: rare classes have few samples within a tier, cross-tier comparisons are unevenly powered, and the L3 share limits the deep tier’s rare classes, so “the deep tier is more concentrated” holds only qualitatively.
blocks.zh: 长尾s. 词汇很长的尾声:罕见的分类在一个层次内没有多少样本,跨层次的比较力量不均匀,L3份额限制了深层的稀有分类,因此"深层比较集中"只具有质的特性.

blocks.en: 6.2 Research Directions
blocks.zh: 6.2 研究方向

blocks.en: None of these questions can be answered on ( o , a ) (o,a) data alone.
blocks.zh: 仅靠数据(o、a)(o、a)无法回答这些问题。

blocks.en: Testing the mediation. One test compares p ⁡ ( a ∣ o , m ) p(a\mid o,m) with p ⁡ ( a ∣ o ) p(a\mid o) : if the proxies add nothing, the latter is no worse. Another is a cross-tier ablation; L1 and L3 share the task ontology and differ in depth, so an L1-trained model applied to L3 mixes distribution shift with the proxy difference. The imagery phase supplies a third: it records a plan without its execution, so a model can be asked to read the plan without action evidence.
blocks.zh: 测试调解。 一种测试将p (a∣,m))p⁡(a\,m))与p⁡(a∣)p⁡(a\)p((a\,mimid):如果代理者不添加任何物,后者也不会更糟糕. 另一种是跨层斜拉;L1和L3共享任务本体学,深度不同,因此一个L3应用的L1训练模型与代理差混合分布位移. 图像阶段提供了第三个:它记录一个计划而不执行,因此可以要求一个模型在没有行动证据的情况下读取计划.

blocks.en: Evaluating before the fact. With only o o and a a a corpus scores after the fact; with intent one can ask before: how the action would change under a different intent, whether the decision stays readable when no action occurs, and whether a model predicts the action or the intent behind it. Such answers do not depend on success, so they retain signal where failures are rare.
blocks.zh: 评估事实之前。 在事实之后,只有o 和一个实体得分;出于意图,人们可以先问:根据不同的意图,行动将如何改变,当没有发生行动时,决定是否仍然可以读取,以及模型是否预测行动或其背后的意图。 这种答案并不取决于成功,因此它们保留着失败罕见的信号.

blocks.en: Transport. Three depths, several sites, many operators, and fourteen units make transport measurable: which proxies stay calibrated across tiers, which labels stay stable across annotators, and whether any component is independent of the sensor.
blocks.zh: 交通运输。 3个深度,多个站点,许多操作员,以及14个单元使运输量可以测量:哪些代位保持跨层校准,哪些标记在注释器之间保持稳定,是否有任何组件独立于传感器.

blocks.en: Applications. Intent-conditioned policies, earlier failure prediction, corrections with less supervision, and an intent interface for human–robot collaboration follow once z z enters the model: the pay-off of the chain, not the test of whether it holds.
blocks.zh: 申请. 意向性政策,早期的失败预测,较少监管的纠正,以及人-机器人协作的意向界面,一旦z z进入模型就遵循: 链条的回报,而不是它是否持有的测试.

blocks.en: The corpus succeeds if it makes these questions falsifiable; a negative answer counts as much as a positive one.
blocks.zh: 如果使这些问题变得可以伪造,则调查程序就成功;否定的答案与肯定的答案一样重要。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: An egocentric manipulation corpus usually records two things: the observation o o and the action a a . It records what happened, not what was decided—and the decision is what the action is answerable to. HumanCOIN takes that middle term, the intent z z , as the object of collection: one task ontology and one time base, with proxies for z z recorded at three signal depths—gaze for attention, EMG for execution, EEG for decision—and three tiers nested in instrumentation but not in distribution: passive and open at L1, active and open at L2, active and controlled at L3. What results is an instrument for testing intent rather than a larger behavioural dataset: task families that recur across tiers observed at several depths, which makes three questions measurable—where intent becomes readable, whether it mediates the action beyond the observation, and whether it transports across tiers.
blocks.zh: 以自我为中心的操纵程序通常记录两件事:观察o和动作a。 它记录了所发生的事情,而不是已经决定的事情,而决定是行动的责任。 HumanCOIN将中词,意为z z,作为收集对象:一个任务本体学和一个时间基,Z的代词记录在三个信号深度上——Gaze用于注意,EMG用于执行,EEG用于决定——以及三个层次的嵌入在仪表中而不是分布中:被动和打开在L1,主动和开放在L2,主动和控制在L3. 哪些成果是测试意图的工具,而不是更大的行为数据集:在几个深度观测到的跨层级重复出现的任务家族,这使三个问题可以衡量——在意图变得可读的情况下,它是否调解了超出观测范围的行动,以及它是否跨层级传输。

blocks.en: We do not claim that these questions are answered; the value of the corpus is that they can be falsified, including by the negative result that intent is redundant with observation. The data, the acquisition software, and the documentation are released openly for research use.
blocks.zh: 我们并不声称这些问题得到了回答;犯罪要件的价值在于它们可能被伪造,包括产生消极的结果,即意图是多余的观察。 数据、获取软件和文件公开发布,供研究使用。

blocks.en: 8 Data Statement
blocks.zh: 第8条 数据语句

blocks.en: All participants gave written informed consent before any recording and could withdraw at any time without penalty. Episodes are released only in de-identified form: no personally identifying information is included, faces are blurred in every released view, and all tiers—L1, L2, and L3—share the same consent and de-identification protocol. Task protocols and instrumentation differ ( Section 4.2 ): L1 is unguided, L2 and L3 use task sheets; L2 adds EMG, and L3 adds EEG and, in the controlled setting, eye tracking and motion capture, all de-identified the same way. Code is released under Apache-2.0 and data under CC BY-NC 4.0.
blocks.zh: 所有与会者在任何录音之前都作了书面知情同意,并且可以随时退出,而不受处罚。 专集只以非识别形式发布:没有包含个人识别信息,每个被发布的观点中面孔模糊,所有层次——L1,L2和L3——共享相同的同意和去识别协议. 任务协议和仪表不同(第4.2节):L1没有制导,L2和L3使用任务表;L2增加了EMG,L3增加了EEG,在控制设置,眼睛跟踪和运动捕捉中,都以同样的方式解析. 代码在Apache-2.0下发布,数据在CC BY-NC 4.0.
