blocks.en: 9 Scene Classes
blocks.zh: 9 场景类

blocks.en: The corpus spans 38 scene classes in 5 zones—residential (9 classes), commercial (10), professional (5), industrial (6), and public (7)—plus one residual class. Table 2 lists all 38 with their hours in each tier, their share of the corpus, and the tiers in which they appear; Figure 6 shows a recorded frame for each.
blocks.zh: 人身保护令在5个区(9个区)、商业(10个区)、专业(5个区)、工业(6个区)和公共(7个区)——加上1个剩余区——共38个场景课。 表2列出了所有38个表格,其中各层次的时数、在表格中所占的份额和显示的级别;图6显示了每个表格的录制框架。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Scene classes in full. Hours are recorded hours by tier; total is the class total over all tiers; share is the percentage of the 12 , 500 12,500 h corpus; tier gives the tiers in which the class appears. Zone headings give the class count, the zone’s hours and share, and the number of classes in L3. Values are rounded to 0.1 h, so rows and columns may not sum exactly.
blocks.zh: 表2:场景课全数. 小时按等级记录;总数是所有等级的班级总数;份额是12,500,12,500赫兹的百分比;分级给出了该等级的级别。 区标题给出了类数,区的时数和分享,以及L3的类数. 数值四舍五入为0.1h,因此行和列可能不准确和.

blocks.en: What a class is. A class names the physical setting in which an episode was recorded, not the activity performed there: the same task may occur in several classes, and a class hosts many tasks. Every episode carries a single scene label, so the class hours partition the corpus and sum to 12 , 500 12,500 . The five zones are functional strata for reporting and stratified use, not a hierarchy—they group settings by primary function (living, commerce, work, production, and public life)—and two classes in one zone need not be closer than two in different zones. The residual class is a label like the others, not missing data: it holds 241.6 h, 1.9% of the corpus, and appears at L1 and L2 but not L3.
blocks.zh: 何等为类. 一个班级名称是记录一集的物理设置,而不是在那里执行的活动:在几个班级中可能发生同样的任务,一个班级会主持许多任务. 每个剧集都有一个单一的场景标签,所以课时会分割出本体,总和为12,500,12,500. 五个区是报告和分层使用的功能阶层,而不是等级——它们按主要功能(生活、商业、工作、生产和公共生活)分类——一个区的两个类别不需要比不同区的两个类别更接近。 剩余类是与其他类相似的标签,而非缺失数据:它持有241.6h,1.9%的体积,出现在L1和L2中,但不是L3中.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Head-camera frames from the scene vocabulary: one frame for each of the 38 classes, labelled with its class name and ordered by zone (square colour) and by recorded hours within a zone. Per-class hours and tier coverage are in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 图6:场景词汇中的头-相机帧:38个类各一个框,标有其类名,按区(平面颜色)和区内记录的时数排序. 每班小时和分级覆盖率见表2。

blocks.en: Boundaries. The label follows the setting in which the hands act for the greater part of the episode; crossing a doorway does not change it. The pairs that carry most of the ambiguity are resolved by function, not by furniture: kitchen against dining room separates preparation and cleanup from eating and serving; office against study separates a workplace from a home workspace, so the same desk task is labelled by the setting; storage room against industrial warehouse separates domestic from industrial storage, and hotel against bedroom a commercial guest room from a home bedroom. In the public zone, street is outdoor circulation, park and garden managed green space, and public facility an indoor public building; restaurant is a sit-down meal and a beverage shop a drinks counter.
blocks.zh: 边界。 标签沿用了手对大部分剧集的动作设定;穿过一个门道并不改变. 承担大部分模糊内容的对子通过功能而不是家具来解决:厨房与餐室分开准备和清洁与饮食和服务;办公室与学习分开工作场所与家庭工作空间,因此同一办公桌任务被设置标签;储存室与工业仓库分开,储存室与工业仓库分开,旅馆与卧室分开,商业客房与家庭卧室分开。 在公共区,街道是户外环流,公园和花园管理着绿色空间,公共设施是室内公共建筑;餐厅是坐餐,饮料店是饮料柜台.

blocks.en: The nine L3 classes. The deep tier does not spread evenly over the vocabulary. Office (162.4 h), dining room (75.2), workroom (65.5), and kitchen (35.1) carry 67.6% of its 500 h; the other five are study (34.5), laboratory (34.1), retail store (32.7), laundry area (30.7), and beverage shop (29.7). The nine span four zones—residential, commercial, professional, and industrial—and no public-zone class reaches L3. The set is therefore concentrated but not confined to one room type: two of its nine classes are shops.
blocks.zh: 九门L3类. 深层不平均分布在词汇上. 办公室(162.4小时)、餐厅(75.2)、工作室(65.5)和厨房(35.1)承载500小时的67.6%;其他五个是学习(34.5)、实验室(34.1)、零售店(32.7)、洗衣区(30.7)和饮料店(29.7)。 9个区——住宅区、商业区、专业区和工业区——没有公共区级达到L3。 因此,该套节目集中但不限于一个房间类型:其9个班级中有两个是商店。

blocks.en: 10 Verb Lexicon
blocks.zh: 10 字词Lexicon

blocks.en: Every step carries two labels rather than one. A task verb names the goal the step accomplishes and is the unit a plan is written in; the motion verbs recorded inside the step name what the hand does to reach that goal, 2.5 of them per step. The two vocabularies are disjoint—no verb appears in both layers—and they behave in opposite ways: the task layer is open and long-tailed, the motion layer closed and concentrated. Table 3 lists both in full, with a boundary statement for each verb, the tiers in which it is observed, and its total occurrences; per-tier counts ship with the release.
blocks.zh: 每个步骤都带有两个而不是一个标签. 一个任务动词将步骤完成的目标命名为单位,是将一个计划写入的单位;将动作动词记录在步骤名称中,手用来达到这个目标,每步2.5个. 这两个词组是脱节的——没有动词出现在两层中——它们的表现方式是相反的:任务层是开放的和长尾的,运动层是封闭和集中的. 表3列出了完整、附有每个动词的边界说明、其观测的层次及其总发生情况;每层次的船舶随释放而计数。

blocks.en: The task layer. 99 verbs over the annotated steps. The ten most frequent take 60.0% of the record and the median verb occurs 81 times, but the tail is long: 28 verbs occur 25 times or fewer, down to uncap at 4. Coverage varies by tier—98 verbs are observed at L1, 79 at L2 and 40 at L3; 34 appear in all three and 15 in only one. What a protocol removes is informative. Fifty-nine verbs are absent at L3, and the ones that matter for the protocol fall into three groups: four are cleaning ( spray , rinse , wash , dry ), six are cord or closure work ( seal , stick , thread , untie , coil , connect ), and four are whole-object actions ( throw , unfold , cover , peel ); tear , which never reaches L2, is absent for a simpler reason. A scripted desk task does not throw, unfold or wash.
blocks.zh: 任务层. 99动词在附加说明的步骤上. 10个最频繁的占记录的60.0%,中位动词发生81次,但尾巴很长:28个动词发生25次或更少,4时降至未盖. 在L1、79在L2和40在L3中观察到的动词有98个,在所有三个中都有34个,只有15个。 协议删除的内容是信息化的。 L3没有59个动词,对协议很重要的动词分为三组:四组是清洗(喷雾,冲洗,洗涤,干燥),六组是绳线或关闭工作(封条,棒,线,不绑,圈,连接),四组是全对象动作(抛,展开,覆盖,剥皮);泪水,从未达到L2,因为更简单的原因没有. 脚本桌面任务不丢弃、展开或洗涤。

blocks.en: The motion layer. 46 verbs over the motion annotations, and effectively a closed set: the four commonest— place , grasp , pick , move —take 82.2% of all motion annotations and the ten most frequent take 92.5%, against 35.8% and 60.0% for the same ranks in the task layer. Every one of the 46 verbs occurs at L1. Twenty-four occur in all three tiers, one ( tilt ) at L1 and L3 only, and 21 are absent at L3, falling into three groups: all six fine-contact verbs ( pinch , poke , feel , rub , tap , squeeze ), all five transport verbs ( carry , drag , slide , transfer , bring ), and ten posture or alignment verbs ( push , lay , spread , roll , stand , dip , lean , bend , extend , retract ). What drops out is contact without motion, and transport over distance.
blocks.zh: 运动层. 46动词凌驾于运动说明之上,实际上是一个封闭的集合:四个最常见的——位置,抓住,摘取,移动——占所有运动说明的82.2%,最频繁的十个占92.5%,而任务层中同一级别的占35.8%和60.0%. 46个动词中每一个都发生在L1. 所有三层都有二十四个,只有L1和L3的1个(倾斜),L3的21个缺位,分为三组:所有6个细接触动词(夹,戳,感觉,擦,踢,挤),所有5个运输动词(携带,拖,滑,移,带),以及10个姿势或对齐动词(推,铺,铺,滚,立,凹,斜,弯,伸,拉). 辍学的就是无动于衷的接触 和远距离运输

blocks.en: The two layers together. The task verb is the sentence a plan is written in and the motion verbs are the record of how the hand executed it, and the tiers treat the two differently: L3 keeps 40 of 99 task verbs (40%) but 25 of 46 motion verbs (54%), and the motion verbs it keeps carry 95.2% of L1’s motion annotations against 77.3% for the task verbs. The decomposition is also finer where the record is deepest—2.50 motion verbs per step at L1, 3.00 at L3—so the deep tier says less about what was done and more about how.
blocks.zh: 两层相合. 任务动词是将一个计划写成的句子,运动动词是手如何执行它的记录,分级对两种不同的处理:L3保留了99个任务动词中的40个(40%),但保留了46个动词中的25个(54%),运动动词则保留着95.2%的L1运动说明,任务动词则保留77.3%. 在记录最深的地方——每步2.50动动词在L1,3.00,L3——分解也比较细,所以深层对做了什么,对如何做,都说得不多.

blocks.en: Table 3: The verb lexicon in full. A task verb names the goal a step accomplishes; a motion verb names what the hand does inside the step. Glosses state the boundary used by the annotators, tiers give where the verb is observed, and share is each verb’s percentage of the annotations in its layer; percentages may not sum to 100 because of rounding.
blocks.zh: 表3:动词词典全文. 一个任务动词将一个步骤完成的目标命名;一个动作动词将手在步骤内做什么. Glosses 表示注释者使用的边界,分级给出动词的观测位置,共享是每个动词在注释层中的百分比;由于四舍五入,百分比可能不等于100.

blocks.en: 11 Object Library
blocks.zh: 11 对象库

blocks.en: Every object an episode touches is an entry of a measured library: 839 instances under 442 distinct names, of which 829 are active and 10 retired, the retired ones shipped with a flag. An entry records a name, a shape together with the parameters that shape calls for, a primary and an optional secondary colour in hexadecimal, a material, a weight, a photograph, and a UUID. The UUID is the only key that joins an entry to the object list written with an episode, so the per-instance table ships with the release and is not printed here. The library grew with collection—35 entry dates between September and November 2026—rather than being assembled in advance.
blocks.zh: 每一集触碰的物体都是一个量度图书库的条目:在442个明显名称下有839个实例,其中829个活跃,10个退休,退休者携带旗帜发运. 一个条目记录一个名称,一个形状以及形状需要的参数,一个十六进制的主色和可选次色,一个材料,一个重量,一个照片,和一个UUID. UUID是唯一一个用插曲写入对象列表条目的密钥,因此带有发行内容的每进表船不在此打印. 图书馆随着藏书的增长——2026年9月至11月的35个入馆日期——而不是提前组装.

blocks.en: Shape. Twelve primitives are in use ( Figure 7 a). Cuboid and cylinder alone account for 715 instances, or 85%; the other ten cover 124, the largest being the frustum (54, the open vessels: cups, bowls, pots, bins) and the torus (18, objects with a through-hole: tape rolls, washers, a bracelet). Size is stored as the parameters the shape calls for—length, width, and thickness for a cuboid, diameter and height for a cylinder or a frustum, three axes for an ellipsoid—so one schema serves a mug, a box, and a sheet. Lengths are read with a caliper and weights on a scale, and both are written to one decimal place, 0.1 cm and 0.1 g, which is the resolution the table carries.
blocks.zh: 形状 12种原始人正在使用(图7a)。 仅Cuboid和气瓶就占715个案例,占85%;另外10个覆盖124个案例,最大的是frustum(54个,开放的容器:杯子,碗,锅,桶)和Torus(18个,带有透孔的物体:磁带卷,洗衣机,手镯). 大小作为参数加以储存,形状要求一个立方体的长度、宽度和厚度、一个圆柱体或圆柱体的直径和高度、一个椭圆形的三轴——所以一个图案为杯子、一个盒子和一张工作表服务。 长度用一个卡路里和一个尺度上的权重来读,两者都写成一个小数位,即0.1cm和0.1g,这是表携带的分辨率.

blocks.en: Size. By longest dimension the median instance is 15 cm, with quartiles at 8.6 and 23 cm. 86 instances are shorter than 5 cm—screws, washers, nuts, the parts a hand manipulates at the fingertips—and 54 reach 40 cm or more, the furniture and fabric at the other end. Between them, 84% of the library falls in 5–40 cm, the range in which a seated operator reaches and grasps ( Figure 7 c).
blocks.zh: 尺寸。 从最长的维度来看,中位点是15厘米,四分点为8.6厘米和23厘米。 86个实例短于5厘米,即指尖上手操纵的部分,另一端的家具和织物达到40厘米或以上。 在它们之间,84%的图书馆在5至40厘米内落下,一个坐着的操作员到达并抓住的范围(图7c)。

blocks.en: Weight and material. Weight spans six orders of magnitude, from 0.02 g (a plastic shaving) to 20 kg (a shelving unit), with a median of 42 g and quartiles at 7 and 172 g. 29% of the instances are under 10 g and only 38, some 4.5%, exceed 1 kg: the library is one of small, light objects ( Figure 7 d). Plastic accounts for 307 entries (37%), paper for 148, metal for 141, together about seven in ten. Weight separates by material ( Figure 7 e): glass and ceramic are highest, at medians of 470 and 326 g, paper lowest at 3.6 g, and plastic and metal both near 40–50 g but with long tails. At a given size it is the material that decides whether an object can be lifted in one hand, which is why it is recorded. The three commonest shape–material pairs are cuboid–plastic (168), cuboid–paper (139), and cylinder–metal (50).
blocks.zh: 重量与材料. 体重从0.02克(塑料剃须)到20公斤(雪壳单位),有6个数量级,其中中位数42克,四分位数7和172克。 29%的情况低于10克,只有38个,约4.5%,超过1公斤:图书馆是一个小型、轻型物体(图7d)。 塑料占307个条目(37%),纸张占148个条目,金属占141个条目,加起来大约是七分之十. 按材料划分的重量(图7e):玻璃和陶瓷最高,中位数为470和326克,纸张最低为3.6克,塑料和金属均接近40-50克,但尾巴很长。 在给定的大小上,是由材料决定一个物体是否可以单手举起,这就是它被记录的原因. 最常用的三种形状-材料对是立体-塑料(168)、立体-纸张(139)和圆柱-金属(50)。

blocks.en: Colour. Colour is the dominant value sampled from the photograph, in hexadecimal, with an optional second value. Mapped to names the library is greyscale-dominated—grey 25%, white 15%, black 13%, brown 11%, transparent 11%—and chromatic objects are only 35% of the total. In CIELAB ( Figure 7 b) most instances sit in the low-chroma band ( C ∗ < 20 C^{*}<20 ), and saturated reds and yellows are rare. Colour is therefore a weak discriminator between objects in one scene, which is why shape and size are recorded beside it.
blocks.zh: 颜色 彩色是从照片中取样的主要值,以十六进制表示,可选的第二值. 以灰度为主-灰度为25%,白色为15%,黑色为13%,棕色为11%,透明为11++和色泽物体仅占总数的35%。 在CIELAB(图7b)中,大多数情况下坐落于低色波段(C * < 20 C^{*}<20),饱和红色和黄色是罕见的. 因此,色彩是一个场景中物体之间的一种弱的区别,这就是为什么在它旁边记录形状和大小的原因.

blocks.en: Counting. The class count of Section 3.4 counts the object classes named by annotators in a step; this appendix counts the physical instances that were measured. Each measured instance carries a UUID that also appears in the object list written with every episode that used it; a class reaches the library only through the instances its steps name. The two counts are therefore not the same number: a class may be realised by several measured instances, and one instance may be named by more than one class.
blocks.zh: 计数中. 第3.4节的类数逐步计算注释者命名的对象类;本附录计算被测量的物理实例. 每个测量实例都带有一个UUID,它也出现在每集使用它时所写的对象列表中;一个类只通过实例其步骤名称到达库. 因此,这两项计数不是相同的数:一个类别可能通过若干计量实例实现,一个类别可能由一个以上类别命名。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : The object library. (a) The twelve shape primitives and their percentage share of the library; the axis is logarithmic, and the solid beside each bar is the primitive. (b) Colour of every instance in CIELAB, lightness against chroma; the dotted line at C ∗ = 12 C^{*}=12 separates the achromatic entries. (c) Longest dimension. (d) Weight, with quartiles dotted and the median dashed. (e) Weight of the ten commonest materials, ordered by median, with each material’s percentage share in brackets. n = 839 n=839 .
blocks.zh: 图7:对象库. (a) 十二形原始人及其在库中的百分比份额;轴为对数,每个栏旁的固体为原始。 (b) CIELAB中每个实例的颜色,对染色体的光度;C * = 12 C = 12 C = 12的点线将色谱条目分开。 (c) 最长的维度。 (d) 重量,四分位数点缀,中位数点缀。 (e) 按中位数订购的十种最常用材料的重量,每种材料的百分比份额放在括号内。 n = 839 n = 839 (韩语).

blocks.en: 12 Hardware Bill of Materials
blocks.zh: 12 硬件清单

blocks.en: Table 4 : Stream specifications of the in-house kit, which records L2 and L3. Every camera records RGB and runs at 30 fps; every view is released raw and rectified, the depth view rectified only; the third-person view exists only in the controlled setting. L1 records on third-party headbands, audited unit by unit in \appref app:l1audit. The pose and hand streams are released as fused outputs at about 800 Hz; the trackers and the glove that feed them run at their own device rates.
blocks.zh: 表4:内部工具包的流程规格,记录L2和L3。 每个相机记录RGB,运行时间为30 fps;每个视图都会被原始释放和修正,深度视图只更正;第三人称视图只存在于控制设置中. L1记录第三方头带,被审计单位在\appref app:l1audit中按单位列示. 姿势和手流作为引信输出释放,约为800赫兹;追踪器和喂养它们的手套以自己的装置速率运行。

blocks.en: Table 4 lists the in-house instruments that record L2 and L3, with the resolution, channel count, rate, and unit of every stream; the L1 headbands are third-party and are audited in \appref app:l1audit. The headband is in-house; the remaining devices are commercial and are used as delivered.
blocks.zh: 表4列出记录L2和L3的内部仪器,并附有每个流的分辨率,频道计数,速率,单位;L1头带为第三方,在\appref app:l1audit中接受审计. 头带是内部的;其余的装置是商用的,在交付时使用.

blocks.en: Headband. Four synchronised lenses sit on a rigid frame with a fixed baseline, so the stereo pair used for depth keeps its geometry across sessions; an inertial unit and the acquisition computer are mounted behind them, and the battery is carried at the back of the band. The band is fitted to the head with a replaceable inner liner, which also keeps the lenses at a repeatable height and angle.
blocks.zh: 头带. 四个同步镜头坐在一个固定基线的刚性框架上,因此用于深度的立体对保持其几何学的跨会场;一个惯性单元和获取计算机被挂在它们后面,电池在波段的后部. 带子安装在头部有可替换的内衬,它也使镜头保持可重复的高度和角度.

blocks.en: Wrist kit. Each wrist carries an armband with eight dry electrodes on the palm side. At L3 the armband is paired with a camera on a strap aimed along the hand, and the two are cabled together so the forearm does not pull on the camera; the pair is worn over the glove, and at L2 only the armband is worn, directly on the forearm.
blocks.zh: 手提包 来 每只手腕搭载一个臂章,手掌一侧有8个干电极. 在L3时,臂章用瞄准手边的带子上的相机进行配对,而两者是连接在一起的,因此前臂不拉在相机上;对子在手套上磨损,在L2时仅佩戴臂章,直接在前臂上.

blocks.en: Cognition kit. The L3 kit adds a binocular eye tracker with its scene camera, three 6-DoF trackers (head and both wrists), a pair of 20-node gloves, and an EEG cap. Two cap types are used: a 128-channel saline cap for the controlled setting and a 32- or 8-channel gel cap for the open setting; both are seated and checked for impedance before each block.
blocks.zh: 认知工具箱. L3套装增加了带有其场景摄像头的双眼跟踪仪,三台6-DoF跟踪仪(头部和两手腕),一对20节手套,以及一个EEG帽. 采用两种盖型:控制设置的128通道盐水盖和开放设置的32通道或8通道胶质盖;两种盖型均在每块前坐好并检查障碍.

blocks.en: Synchronisation hardware. A UDP marker is emitted by the recorder, and phase and run transitions are additionally driven through a parallel-port box into the EEG amplifier, so protocol events are stamped on the amplifier clock as well as on the host clock. Cameras, headband, and eye tracker are calibrated before each session against a printed target; the resulting intrinsics, distortion, and tracker transforms ship with the episode.
blocks.zh: 同步硬件. 一个UDP标记由记录器释放,相位和运行的过渡通过一个平行的端口盒额外驱动进入EEG放大器,因此协议事件在放大器时钟和主机时钟上都加盖印章. 相机,头带,和眼睛跟踪器在每次会话之前对一个印刷的目标进行校准;由此产生的内在,扭曲,和跟踪器会随剧集一起改变飞船.

blocks.en: Consumables and spares. Saline, gel, syringes, electrode paste, spare straps, liners, and batteries are restocked per shift; a failed cap or camera is swapped and the session restarted rather than repaired in place, so that a released episode never mixes two calibrations.
blocks.zh: 消耗品和备用品。 莎琳,凝胶,注射器,电极贴,备用带,衬垫和电池每班都要重新装好;一个故障盖或相机被换掉,会话重新开始而非修复到位,这样一集释放出来的剧集就不会混合两个校准.

blocks.en: 13 L1 Source Audit
blocks.zh: 13 L1 来源审计

blocks.en: Why an audit. L1 is the only tier whose hardware is not ours, and it is not one device: it is a collection layer of fourteen headbands from thirteen vendors. Everything the corpus reports for L1 is conditioned on what those units physically provide—the view gaze is inferred from, the pair that depth is reconstructed from, the rate the hands are estimated at—so the layer is only interpretable if that condition is written down unit by unit. The audit records it, so that a result can be read against the unit it came from and the layer can be reproduced.
blocks.zh: 为什么是审计? L1是硬件不是我们的唯一的一级,也不是一个设备:它是13个销售商的14个头带的收集层. L1的生物体报告都以这些单位实际提供的情况为条件——视线是从中推断出来的,从深度重建的对子,估计手的速率——因此,只有按单位将这一条件写下来,才能解释该层。 审计记录,以便对照其所属单位阅读结果,层层可复制.

blocks.en: What is recorded. Four properties are taken from each unit rather than from its documentation. The lens set and the direction of every view are read off the device. Native resolution and frame rate are measured on the recorded stream, not on the specification sheet. Whether the main view is a genuine stereo pair is checked on synchronized frames: twelve of the fourteen provide one, two of them as a single side-by-side image that the pipeline splits into left and right, and one through a pair of its positioning cameras (up, down, left, and right) rather than a dedicated front pair; units 2 and 7 are fisheye arrays without a stereo pair. The stream is then classified as raw or pre-processed, because the domain matters downstream: one unit delivers only rectified 512 × 512 512\times 512 frames, one delivers the pair already split, and one adds an extension view beside the pair.
blocks.zh: 记录了什么? 四个属性取自每个单元,而不是其文件。 镜头集和每个视图的方向都从设备上读出. 原生分辨率和帧速率在记录流上进行测量,而不是在规格表上进行. 主视图是否为真立体对在同步帧上检查: 十四组中的十二组提供一对,其中两对作为管道分割成左右的单侧图像,一对通过它的定位相机(上,下,左,右)而不是专用的前对; 2和7组是鱼眼阵列,没有立体对. 随后溪流被归类为原始或预处理,因为域名事项下游:一个单元交付只纠正512×512 512\times 512帧,一个送出对已拆分,一个在对侧添加扩展视图.

blocks.en: What the variation implies. Pairing decides how a depth estimate is formed, and the pairs differ—a dedicated front rig, a side-by-side image split after the fact, or two positioning cameras—so the audit records the configuration each episode rests on, and a result that depends on the pair is stated with the unit it came from. Optics trade coverage against geometry: the seven units with fisheye or side views see further around the operator, but every unit is rectified to a common pinhole domain before estimation, so the peripheral views buy coverage rather than accuracy, and their corners are lost at rectification ( Section 5 ). Rate and resolution set the domain in which every L1 estimate lives: from 512 × 512 512\times 512 at 20 Hz to 3840 × 1200 3840\times 1200 at 60 Hz. Nothing is resampled to a common grid at write time ( Section 4.3 ), so an estimator trained on one unit is trained in that unit’s domain, and the audit is what allows the domain to be declared. Table 5 lists the units, numbered by collection volume, with two packaged sets from one vendor taking consecutive numbers; vendor, model, and toolchain names are withheld, so the table documents capability rather than procurement.
blocks.zh: 变化意味着什么。 配对决定了深度估计的形成方式,对子不同——一个专用的前置钻机,一个在事实发生之后的侧面图像分割,或者两个定位摄像头——因此,审计记录了每集的配置依据,结果取决于对子与它来自的单位表示. 视线交易覆盖与几何:有鱼眼或侧视的7个单元在操作者周围看到更多,但每个单元在估算前被修正到一个常见的针孔域,因此外围视图购买覆盖而不是精确度,它们的角在修正时丢失(第5节). 速率和分辨率设定了每个L1估计寿命的域:从512×512 512\时的512x20Hz到3840×1200 3840\时的1200x60Hz. 没有任何东西在写时被重印到一个共同的网格(第4.3节),因此一个受过一个单位训练的估测员在那个单位的域中接受训练,审计是允许宣布域名的. 表5列出了按收集量编号的单位,从一个供应商中抽取了连续编号的两套包件;不保留供应商、模型和工具链名称,因此表格记录能力而不是采购。

blocks.en: Table 5 : L1 source audit. Vendor, model, and toolchain names are withheld; units are numbered by collection volume, and two packaged sets from the same vendor take consecutive numbers. Views give the direction of each lens, with fisheye marked explicitly. Cameras counts the physical lenses of the unit; Views lists the released views. The two differ where one lens contributes more than one view (a side-by-side pair split into left and right, or an extension view) or where a lens is not released as a separate view.
blocks.zh: 表5:L1来源审计。 供应商、模型和工具链名称不设;单位按收集量编号,同一供应商的两套包装套件连续编号。 观点给出了每个镜头的方向,明确标注鱼眼. 相机计算单元的物理透镜; 视图列出释放的视图. 两者不同之处是,一个镜头贡献了不止一个视图(一个侧面对子分割成左侧和右侧,或扩展视图),或者一个镜头不作为单独的视图释放.

blocks.en: 14 Episode File Layout
blocks.zh: 14 集文件布局

blocks.en: Every episode is self-contained and follows a chunked hierarchy compatible with a modified LeRobot v3.1 release. The directory is named after the session (collector, date, clock). Every camera is released twice, raw and rectified, and the electrophysiology is released both raw and cleaned. The example in Figure 8 holds 1,444 master frames (48.1 s), 17 videos, one audio track, and 42 Parquet tables.
blocks.zh: 每集都是自成一体的,并遵循一个与修改后的LeRobot v3.1发行相兼容的块级. 目录以会话(集合,日期,时钟)命名. 每台相机都要放出两次,原始的和修正的,电生理学同时放出原始的和清洁的. 图8中的例子有1,444个主帧(48.1 s),17个视频,1个音频音轨,42个Parquet表.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Episode file layout. One episode directory, L3-example/ , with its tables, videos, audio, calibration, annotation, and metadata. <signal> expands to the 23 stream tables, <view> to the 17 camera views (each with a timestamp table and one mp4 per encoding, raw and rectified, except depth, which is rectified only), and <stream> to the microphone stream.
blocks.zh: 图8:Episode文件布局. 1集目录,L3-示例/ ,包含其表格,视频,音频,校准,注释,以及元数据. < signal > 扩展至23个流表, < view > 扩展至17个相机视图(每个相机均带有时间戳表和每个编码、原始和修正的1 mp4,但深度除外,仅更正), < 流 > 扩展至麦克风流。

blocks.en: Signals. Each stream is one Parquet file on its own time base, with a timestamp column in seconds from episode start and an episode_index ; columns are named after channels ( FP1 …), joints ( node00_x …), or dim_0 …for EMG, so no stream is snapped to the master grid. The pose and hand streams are fusion outputs and carry the timestamps of the fused track rather than of a single device. Pixels are not stored in Parquet: observation.images.*.parquet lists the timestamp of every frame and the frames themselves live in the matching mp4 (H.264, 30 fps), one for the raw view and one for its rectified counterpart; depth ships rectified only. Audio is 16 kHz mono PCM in wav, with its Parquet file recording the sample count per master frame. The names are literal: eeg_raw is the record as acquired, eeg the filtered trace, and eeg_repair the trace after bad-channel interpolation and component removal, while each wrist EMG ships as a raw trace beside its envelope. Table 6 lists the shape and the fields of every signal table.
blocks.zh: 信号 每个流是一个Parquet文件在自己的时间基数上,从插曲开始的几秒钟内有一个时间戳柱和一个sit_index;列以频道(FP1...),关节(node00_x...)命名,或dim_0. 对于EMG来说,没有流断裂到主网格. 姿势和手流是聚变输出,并带有引信轨迹的时间戳,而不是单个设备。 像素不存储在Parquet:观察. 图像.*.parquet列出每个帧的时间戳,帧本身生活在匹配的mp4(H.264, 30 fps),一个用于原始视图,一个用于修正的对应;深度舰只修正。 音频为wav中的16 kHz单PCM,其Parquet文件记录每个主帧的样本数. 名称是字面的:eeg_raw是已获得的记录,eeg是过滤的微量,在坏通道内插和组件清除后eeg_修复微量,而每只手腕EMG船作为原始微量在其信封旁. 表6列出了每个信号表的形状和字段.

blocks.en: Table 6: The 23 signal tables: per-frame shape and the fields each one carries.
blocks.zh: 表6: 23个信号表:每帧形状和每个带的字段.

blocks.en: Metadata. info.json records the codebase version, master feature, fps, path templates, chunk size, and the shape and channel names of every feature. episodes.jsonl and tasks.jsonl map indices to the task string and episode length. collect_info.jsonl stores collector, hardware, scene, the object list (colour, shape, dimensions, material, pose), and free-text notes. alignment_check.jsonl reports, per feature, the tolerance, number of readings, violations, and maximum offset, and episodes_stats.jsonl stores per-feature min, max, mean, and standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 元数据。 info.json记录了密码库版本,主特性,fps,路径模板,块大小,以及每个特性的形状和频道名称. 剧集。 jsonl和任务。 jsonl 映射到任务字符串和插曲长度的索引 。 collect_info.jsonl 存储收藏器,硬件,场景,对象列表(颜色,形状,尺寸,材料,姿势),以及自由文本注释. 校正_check.jsonl 报告,每个功能,可容忍度,读数,违反,和最大偏移,以及seric_stats.jsonl存储每位元,最大,平均,和标准偏差.

blocks.en: Calibration and annotation. calibrations/ holds what the tables reference: the reference cameras with per-view rate, frame count, size, and intrinsics, and the P1/P2 projections the rectification applied. annotation/ holds the structured annotation—scene, objects, timed subtask segments, tasks, key events, state changes—and the QC gate with its checks and warnings.
blocks.zh: 校准与注释. 校准/ 持有表格中参考的内容: 具有每个视图率、帧数、大小和内在内容的参考相机,以及应用的P1/P2校正预测。 注释/ 持有结构化的注释- 场景、 对象、 计时的子任务段、 任务、 关键事件、 状态变化, 以及 QC 门及其检查和警告 。

blocks.en: Reading. The reader fixes a master rate (30 fps by default) and walks master_index ; each row gives a time, and every other stream is resolved from its own timestamps by nearest sample, linear interpolation, or all samples in a window such as ( − 1 / FPS , 0 ] (-1/\mathrm{FPS},0] . Nothing is stored on the master grid, so a stream can be re-read at any rate without degradation: a query that needs raw EMG reads the 2 kHz table directly, while a query that needs one frame per 33 ms reads the index and never touches the other tables.
blocks.zh: 读书. 读取器会修正主速率(默认情况下为30英尺)和行走主_index;每行给出一个时间,其他每条流通过最近的样本,线性插图解决,或者在窗口中的所有样本,如(− 1 / FPS, 0) (-1/\mathrm{FPS}, 0). 没有东西存储在主网格上,所以一个流可以不降解地随时重新读取:一个需要原始EMG直接读取2 kHz表的查询,而一个每33ms需要一个帧的查询读取索引,从不触及其他表.

blocks.en: 15 Quality Control
blocks.zh: 15 质量控制

blocks.en: Every session is checked after it is written and before it enters the release. The checker walks each recorder’s output directory—the NPZ arrays, the MP4 containers, and the logs—and returns, per stream, a verdict with its evidence attached; no stream is re-recorded and nothing is repaired. A stream that fails is not patched: the whole session is recaptured, so that a released episode never mixes a good half with a repaired one.
blocks.zh: 每次会话在写完之后和进入发行前都会检查. 检查器将每个记录器的输出目录—— NPZ 阵列、 MP4 容器和日志—— 并返回每个流, 并附上其证据; 没有流被重新记录, 什么都没有被修复 。 一个失败的流没有补丁:整个会话被重新抓回,这样一集发布的剧集就永远不会将好半的剧集与修复的剧集混为一谈.

blocks.en: Alignment comes first. All checks run inside the analysis window bounded by the run_start and run_end markers. The pair is a hard precondition: if it is missing, empty, or unpaired, the session is reported as an error rather than checked against the whole recording, because without the window every per-stream crop and comparison is undefined. The same rule applies to the clock: the EEG stream is accepted only when the amplifier clock was fitted to the host clock, and a failed fit is an error, not a warning.
blocks.zh: 先对齐 以 run_ start 和 run_end 标记为界的分析窗口内运行的所有检查 。 配对是一个硬先决条件:如果缺少,空的,或者没有被封存,则会话被报告为错误,而不是对照整个记录来检查,因为没有窗口,每个每条流的作物和比较都是未定义的. 同样的规则也适用于时钟: EEG流只有在放大器时钟被安装到主机时才会被接受,一个失败的配位是错误而不是警告.

blocks.en: Two verdicts reach the release. Each check yields a finding at one of three levels, of which two matter downstream. An error means the data cannot be used—a corrupt container, a frame count that disagrees with the timestamps, a missing marker pair, a tracker that was absent when the recorder opened—and the session is recaptured. A warning means the data is usable but carries a documented defect: a 2 s frozen stretch, a dead channel, a tracker that lost sight for part of the window, a gap shorter than the threshold for an error. Informational findings, such as the phone-to-host clock correction, never gate anything. Thresholds are the checks’ own defaults and are reported with the observed value.
blocks.zh: 两项判决达成释放. 每一次检查都得出三个等级中的一个结果,其中两个等级在下游。 错误意味着数据不能被使用——一个腐败的容器,一个与时间戳不一致的帧计数,一个缺失的标记对,一个记录器打开时缺失的跟踪器——并且会话被重拾. 警告表示数据可以使用,但带有文件记载的缺陷:2s的冷冻拉伸,死通道,部分窗口失明的跟踪器,漏洞比一个错误的阈值短. 信息发现,如电话对主机时钟校正, 从来不打开任何东西。 阈值是检查本身的默认值,并用观测值报告。

blocks.en: What is checked. The checks run across the nine stream families the kit produces, and each is an independent, thresholded verdict: a modality declares the checks that apply to it, and a shared context loads the NPZ once and decodes each video once, so the checks compose without repeating work. Table 7 lists the families and the default thresholds. Timing checks ask whether a series is usable at all (present, finite, ordered, distinct), whether the cadence is steady, whether an interval jumped far above the median, whether samples are missing, and whether the rate held inside a one-second window—the last of these catches a drop that a mean would hide. Signal checks ask whether the values are plausible: NaN fractions, channels that never move, robust outliers, physical bounds, and motions no body could make. Modality checks are specific to one instrument’s failure modes: the EEG amplifier’s clock fit, fixed-size blocks and header sample count, the EMG armband’s shared 8-bit serial counter, the glove skeleton dropping out window by window, the tracker count and per-tracker validity, and the camera set the headband promised at stream start. Video checks decode every file once and compare the container’s frame count and pixel statistics against the timestamps, which is the only way to see a writer that fell behind silently; the container test uses the same ffprobe criterion as the packaging gate. Session checks close the window: the run_start / run_end pair and the recorder logs.
blocks.zh: 检查什么? 检查横跨套件制作的9个溪流家庭,每个溪流家庭都是独立的,有门槛的判断:一种模式宣布适用于它的检查,一个共享的上下文加载NPZ一次并解码每段视频一次,因此检查不重复工作即可编曲. 表7列出了家庭和默认阈值。 时间检查询问一个系列是否完全可以使用(现在、有限、命令、区别)、节奏是否稳定、间隔是否远远高于中位数、样本是否缺失、以及是否在一秒钟的窗口内保持了速度——其中最后一点捕获到一个平均值会隐藏的下降。 信号检查询问这些值是否合理 : 纳恩分数 永不移动的通道 坚固的外线 物理极限 以及身体无法移动的动作 模式检查是一个仪器故障模式的特异性: EEG 放大器的时钟合适,固定大小的块和头标样本计数,EMG臂章共享的8位串行计数器,手套骨架逐窗抛出,追踪器计数和每轨器有效性,相机设定了溪流开始时承诺的头标. 视频检查一次解码每个文件,并将容器的帧数和像素统计与时间戳进行比较,这是看到一个作家默默落后的唯一方法;容器测试使用与包装门相同的ffprobe标准. 会话检查关闭窗口: 运行_ start / 运行_ 端对 和记录器日志 。

blocks.en: Table 7: Quality-control families and default thresholds. A row is a family of checks; where its sub-checks differ in level, both are listed. A session’s outcome is the worst finding across its streams and its session-level checks, and ERROR blocks packing. Thresholds are code defaults, overridable in configs/checker.yaml ; not every check runs on every stream.
blocks.zh: 表7:质量控制家庭和默认阈值。 一行是检查的家族;如果其子检查的级别不同,则列出两者. 届会的结果是其各流及其会议级别检查和错误反应区块包装中最糟糕的发现。 阈值是代码默认值,在配置/检查器中是压倒性的. Yaml;不是每个检查都运行在每个溪流。

blocks.en: The verdict travels with the episode. The checker writes one report per session and its summary is copied into the episode metadata; an optional self-contained page renders the same findings on one time axis for review. Each finding names the check that produced it, the field or file it concerns, the sub-stream it belongs to where there is one (a tracker serial, a channel index), the threshold and the observed value, and the time span of the problem; a warning is therefore a pointer to the affected seconds, not a blanket statement about the recording.
blocks.zh: 判决随剧集一同进行. 检查者每个会话写一个报告,其摘要被复制到插曲元数据中;一个可选的自成一体的页面在一个时间轴上得出同样的结论以供审查. 每个查找生成它的检查名称,它涉及的字段或文件,它所属的子流有1个(一个跟踪器序列,一个频道索引),阈值和观测值,以及问题的时间跨度;因此,警告指向受影响的秒数,而不是关于录音的总括声明.

blocks.en: Recapture and what it costs. Because an error retires the whole session, the pass rate is a property of the kit rather than of the analysis: more than 99 % 99\% of L1 recordings, 96 % 96\% of L2 and 78 % 78\% of L3 pass. The gradient is the instrumentation. L1 has a single headband; L2 adds two armbands whose electrodes must hold contact through sweat and movement; L3 adds the EEG cap, which must reach impedance on enough channels, the gloves and three trackers, each able to be absent at open or lose sight mid-window, and the eye tracker, whose clock must be fitted. The deepest tier, which is also the smallest, is therefore the tier most often repeated.
blocks.zh: 复取及其费. 由于一个错误会让整个会话退休,通过率是套件的属性而不是分析的属性:超过99%的L1录音,96%的L296XX,78%的L3通过. 梯度是仪表. L1有一个单头带;L2增加了两个臂带,其电极必须通过汗和运动保持接触;L3增加了EEG盖,它必须在足够的通道上达到阻塞,手套和三个追踪器,每个都能够在开窗时缺席或失去视线的中窗,眼睛跟踪器,其时钟必须安装. 因此,最深层也是最小的,是最经常重复的。

blocks.en: Before recording. On the floor, four checks—camera labels against the live tiled view, wrist-camera seating, EMG contact, and tracker visibility—must pass before a session starts; any re-plugged or swapped device triggers all four again, and the passing screen is photographed and filed, so a session without evidence counts as unchecked. A disk-space gate refuses a recording below 50 GB and warns below 100 GB.
blocks.zh: 录前. 在地板上,有四次检查——对活的平面、手腕摄像头座椅、EMG接触和追踪器可见度的检查——必须在会话开始前通过;任何重插或互换的设备都会再次触发所有四个,经过的屏幕会被拍照和归档,因此没有证据的会话算不上是不受控制的。 一个磁盘空间门拒绝50GB以下的录音,警告100GB以下.

blocks.en: What the gate does not cover. The automated layer tests data integrity, not semantics. It does not verify annotation boundaries, task labels, object attributes, or calibration accuracy beyond the presence of a fitted clock; those remain with the annotation review. It is also per session, so cross-session consistency—one operator, scene, or unit behaving differently across sessions—is outside its scope. The checks are meant to separate a usable recording from an unusable one, not to rank two usable recordings against each other.
blocks.zh: 门没有遮挡什么 自动层测试数据完整性,而非语义. 它不核查说明的界限、任务标签、对象属性或校准精度,超出一个装配的时钟的存在范围;这些都属于说明审查范围。 它也是每场会议,所以跨场会议的一致性——一个操作员、场景或不同场次行事的单位——不属于其范围。 这些检查是为了将一个可用的录音与一个无法使用的录音分开,而不是将两个可用的录音排在不同的位置。

blocks.en: 16 Synchronization Audit
blocks.zh: 16 同步审计

blocks.en: Measurement. Synchronization is audited against the protocol markers rather than inferred from the recorder. For each audited L3 episode we take the six phase cues ( instr_on , instr_off , img_start , img_end , exec_start , exec_end ) and, for every stream, the sample nearest each cue; the event-locked residual is the nearest sample time minus the cue time. EEG is split by amplifier: Neuroscan 128-channel at 1 kHz and BrainCo 32/8-channel at 250 Hz.
blocks.zh: 测量。 同步是根据协议标记进行审计的,而不是从记录器中推断出来的. 对于每一个经审核的L3插曲,我们采取6个阶段的提示(instr_on, instr_off, img_start, img_end, exec_start, exec_end),对于每个流,每个提示最接近的样本;事件锁定的剩余是最近的样本时间减去提示时间. EEG被放大器分割:Neuroscan 128通道在1kHz,BrainCo 32/8通道在250Hz.

blocks.en: Reading the table. For regular sampling at period T T , the nearest-sample residual lies within ± T / 2 \pm T/2 , and a uniform residual has an interquartile range (IQR) of about T / 2 T/2 . An IQR close to the half-period therefore indicates that the residual is set by sampling quantization rather than by a clock offset; the normalized column makes this comparison explicit. A value near one is the quantization floor, and a value well above one indicates additional timing irregularity.
blocks.zh: 读经席. 对于T T 期的定期取样,最接近的样本残留位于 ± T / 2\pm T / 2 之间,一个统一的残留具有约 T / 2 T 的方位范围(IQR). 因此,接近半期的IQR表明,残余物是通过采样量化确定的,而不是通过时钟抵消确定的;经过规范的栏目明确了这种比较。 靠近一个值的值是量化底,一个远高于一个值的值表示额外的时间不规则.

blocks.en: Table 8 : Event-locked synchronization residuals on released L3 episodes. Each episode contributes six protocol cues; EEG is split by amplifier (Neuroscan, 1 kHz; BrainCo, 250 Hz). Residual is the nearest released sample minus the cue timestamp; IQR is the interquartile range; P95 and Max are absolute. The normalized column divides the IQR by half the sampling period, so values near one are at the quantization floor. n.r. marks drift not resolvable over a 40 s episode.
blocks.zh: 表8:发布L3集上的事件锁定同步剩余. 每集贡献6个协议提示;EEG由放大器分割(Neuroscan, 1 kHz; BrainCo, 250 Hz). 残留是最近发布的样本减去提示时间戳;IQR是间位范围;P95和Max是绝对的. 归一列将IQR除以采样期的一半,因此一个附近的值处于定量底. 在40 s 的剧集中,没有可解决的标记漂移。

blocks.en: Results. Table 8 shows that the high-rate streams reach the sampling floor. The 1 kHz EEG has a median residual of + 0.10 +0.10 ms and an IQR of 0.47 ms, against a half-period of 0.50 ms; the 2 kHz EMG bands have IQRs of 0.27 and 0.22 ms against 0.25 ms; and the fused 480–940 Hz pose stream has an IQR of 1.04 ms against about 0.80 ms, its half-period at the median rate of 628 Hz. Their IQR/half-period ratios are 0.93, 1.08, 0.87, and 1.30, with no systematic offset beyond sampling quantization. The 250 Hz EEG (IQR 2.22 ms) and the 200 Hz gaze (IQR 2.29 ms) are quantized at their 4 ms and 5 ms sample periods; their ratios of 1.11 and 0.91 place them at the same floor, and they should not be read as less well synchronized.
blocks.zh: 结果。 表8显示,高流流达到采样底. 1kHz EEG的中位残值为+0.10+0.10 ms,IQR为0.47 ms,半周期为0.50 ms;2kHz EMG波段的IQR为0.27和0.22 ms,0.25 ms;引信为480–940 Hz 姿势流的IQR为1.04 ms,约0.80 ms,其半个周期的中位率为628 Hz. 他们的IQR/半期比率为0.93、1.08、0.87和1.30,除抽样定量外没有系统抵销。 250 Hz EEG(IQR 2.22 ms)和200 Hz 凝视(IQR 2.29 ms)按其4 ms和5 ms的采样期进行定量;其1.11和0.91的比例将它们放在同一个楼层,不应该被读得不太同步.

blocks.en: Drift. The residual trend is + 0.35 +0.35 ms/min for the 1 kHz EEG (median; episode range 0.03–0.92) and + 0.09 +0.09 / + 0.15 +0.15 ms/min for the two EMG bands (episode range − 0.60 -0.60 to + 0.34 +0.34 ); the EEG and EMG residuals stay within ± 1 \pm 1 ms/min ( ± 17 \pm 17 ppm) over the episode. For the remaining streams (250 Hz EEG, 200 Hz gaze, 30 Hz camera, and the fused pose output) the sample period exceeds the drift resolvable in 40 s, and the table marks drift as not resolvable. The audit supports the synchronization claim of Section 5.1 : each device keeps its own clock, and the released streams are aligned to a common time base through markers and arrival offsets, not through a shared hardware clock.
blocks.zh: 流转. 1kHz EEG的残存趋势为+0.35+0.35 ms/min(中间;插曲范围为0.03-0.92)和+0.09+0.09 / + 0.15+0.15 ms/min(两个EMG频段的残存趋势为−0.60-0.60至+0.34+0.34); EEG和EMG的残存停留在剧集的±1\pm 1 ms/min(±17\pm 17 ppm)以内. 对于其余的溪流(250 Hz EEG,200 Hz 凝视,30 Hz 相机,以及引信摆放输出),样本期超过40 s 的漂移可溶解度,表标漂移为无法溶解. 审计支持第5.1节的同步主张:每个设备都保留自己的时钟,通过标记和到达抵消,而不是通过共享的硬件时钟,释放出来的流与共同的时间基一致.

blocks.en: Timestamp integrity. The high-rate streams are regular: EEG at both configurations has no duplicate timestamps and no interval beyond five median intervals, and EMG has no duplicate timestamps. The fused pose stream is less regular: across the audited episodes it contains 39 duplicate timestamps and six intervals beyond five median intervals, and its rate ranges from 480 to 940 Hz (median 628 Hz) rather than the nominal 800 Hz. The 30 Hz camera streams are the least regular: the head RGB stream in these episodes contains twelve duplicate timestamps, and every camera container holds 24–72 frames more than its timestamp table (28–67 for the head RGB stream). The excess is consistent with pre- and post-roll frames outside the episode window; those frames are not represented in the Parquet table, so a reader should index the episode through the timestamp table rather than through the container frame number.
blocks.zh: 时间戳的完整性。 高速率流是规律的:两种配置的EEG都没有重复的时间戳,间隔也不超过5个中位间隔,EMG也没有重复的时间戳. 引信式的浮雕流不太经常:在审计的各集中,它包含39个重复的印记和超过5个中位间隔的6个间隔,其速率在480至940赫兹(中间628赫兹)之间,而不是名义上的800赫兹. 30赫兹相机流是最不经常的:这些集中的主RGB流包含12个重复的印记,每个相机容器的装帧比其时间戳表多24–72帧(头RGB流为28–67). 超出部分与插曲窗口外的卷前和卷后帧一致;这些帧没有在Parquet表格中体现,因此读者应该通过时间戳表而不是通过容器帧号来索引插曲.

blocks.en: 17 Electrophysiology Processing
blocks.zh: 17 巨噬生物学处理

blocks.en: Every stage below runs on the raw stream, and its parameters are logged with the episode; the chain is fixed across sessions so that the same code can be replayed on any release.
blocks.zh: 下面的每个阶段都运行在原始流上,其参数随插曲一起记录;链条被固定跨会话,以便在任何发行版本上可以重播相同的代码.

blocks.en: EMG. (1) Mirror padding : the trace is reflected about its first and last sample, filtered, and cropped back to its original length, which suppresses the transient a filter otherwise leaves at the boundary. (2) High-pass , 20 Hz, second-order Butterworth: removes baseline drift and part of the motion artefact, and a Butterworth response is maximally flat in the passband. (3) Low-pass , 450 Hz, fourth-order Butterworth: bounds the analysis band; a digital filter cannot undo aliasing already introduced at sampling. (4) Zero-phase filtering : the sections are applied forward and then backward, so the interior response has zero phase and the magnitude is the square of the one-way response, an order doubled and a steeper roll-off at the cut-off. (5) Comb notch , 50 Hz with a 2 Hz bandwidth ( Q = 50 / 2 = 25 Q=50/2=25 ): periodic nulls at the mains and its harmonics; the backward pass deepens and widens each null, and also attenuates genuine EMG in the same bands. (6) Periodic extension : the edge periods are repeated so that the comb has boundary data, which holds only as far as the edges represent the interference. (7) Period alignment : anomalous edge periods are detected and replaced by interior ones, which rewrites boundary samples and can touch real transients. (8) Endpoint damping : decaying edge energy is detected and cross-faded toward the interior, which removes residual ringing at the cost of possibly attenuating a genuine activation. The cleaned trace is then rectified and low-pass filtered into one envelope per channel.
blocks.zh: EMG (英语). (1) 镜面粘贴:微量反映于其第一个和最后一个样本,经过过滤,并被收割回原长度,这抑制了瞬态的滤波器在边界上离开。 (2)High-pass,20Hz,二阶巴特沃斯:去除基线漂移和部分运动动动动脉动,一个巴特沃斯反应在通过带中最大程度的平整. (3) 低通,450 Hz,第四顺序Butterworth:将分析波段绑定;数字滤波器无法取消在取样时已经引入的别名. (4)零相过滤 :各段先采用前向后向,因此内部反应为零相,规模为单向响应的正方形,订单翻倍,截断时转速较陡. (5)Comb notch ,50Hz带宽为2Hz(Q=50 / 2 = 25 → 50/2=25):在主线及其谐波处周期性无声;落后的传球会加深和拓宽每个无声段,并且也会在同一频段中削弱真正的EMG. (6)周期延伸 :边缘周期重复,使梳子有边界数据,只有边缘代表干扰时才保持边界数据. (7)期对齐 :检测到异常的边缘时段,由内侧时段取代,内侧时段重写边界标本,可以触摸真实的瞬态. (8) 端点加固:检测到衰变边缘能量,并交叉向内侧加固,从而去除残留振铃,而代价可能是削弱真正的激活。 清理后的跟踪被纠正,低通道被过滤成每个通道一个信封.

blocks.en: EEG. The chain is DC removal by the per-channel median, a 0.5–100 Hz band-pass with the high cut clamped below Nyquist, and a 50 Hz notch, followed by four stages. Bad channels are flagged by five joint rules: flat ( σ < 0.2 ​ μ \sigma<0.2\,\mu V with more than 70% of sample differences below 0.02 ​ μ 0.02\,\mu V); contact (robust z z of σ \sigma above 3.5, or above 3.0 with σ > 25 ​ μ \sigma>25\,\mu V); bridging (a neighbouring pair whose electrical distance stays below 16 μ \mu V 2 for more than half of the 2 s epochs and below half the reference of their other neighbours); decorrelation (maximum | r | |r| against any other channel below 0.4 in more than 20% of 1 s windows); and high-frequency noise (robust z z above 5 of the 30–100 Hz to 1–30 Hz MAD ratio). Frontal channels are excused a contact flag when no other rule fires. A session passes when fewer than 30% of its channels are flagged. ICA is infomax with up to 32 components, capped at the number of retained channels, fitted once on the clean segments of a session concatenated in time, with flagged channels held out; ocular components are those correlated with the frontal proxy channels, at most two, and muscle components those whose 30–100 Hz power ratio is a robust z > 3 z>3 above the other components, capped at 20% of the retained channels. Interpolation is spherical spline over the retained channels, and the cleaned trace is finally re-referenced to their average.
blocks.zh: EEG(英语:EEG). 链条是按每通道中位数清除DC 0.5-100 Hz带-通过,在Nyquist下方夹着高的切口,以及一个50Hznoch,然后是四个阶段. 坏渠道有五个共同规则:平坦( < 0.2 μ\sigma < 0.2\,\mu V,样本差异70%以上低于0.02 μ 0.02\,\mu V);接触(3.5以上\sigma的robust z或3.0以上的robust z, > 25\sigma > 25\,\mu V);连接(电距低于16 μ\mu V 2的相邻配对超过2个宿主的一半,低于其他宿主的一半);装饰(在1个窗口的20%以上与0.4以下的任何其他信道相比最大X r & r|);高频噪声(30-100赫兹至1-30赫兹 MAD比率的robust z 5以上)。 在没有其他规则起火时,前方渠道可以免去接触旗. 当不到30%的频道被标出时,会话就会结束。 ICA是信息元件,最多32个元件,封顶在保留通道数量上,一次安装在及时整齐的会话的干净部分上,并有标注的通道;视星等元件是与前代通道相关,最多两个,肌肉元件为30-100 Hz功率比是高于其他组件的强力z > 3 z>3,上限为保留信道的20%. 内插在保留通道上是球状的斑点,被清理的踪迹最终被重新参照它们的平均值.

blocks.en: Montage and regions. Every channel of the release carries a conventional scalp label and the region group of its row in Table 9 . The 128-channel saline cap covers the full conventional set plus the intermediate positions, including the mastoids and the two cerebellar electrodes; the 32-channel gel cap is a subset of it with two auxiliary channels; and the 8-channel gel cap keeps two frontal-central, two central, one midline parietal, and three occipital sites.
